# 1. Description

## 1.1 Study design

The TargetC cohort is an adenoma follow-up study. MAG-level genomes were
recovered from 393 metagenomic samples, and their microbial phenotypes were
predicted with three complementary tools across six clinical groups:

| Group | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| N     | Normal (endoscopy-normal control) |
| Re1   | Recurrence_1 (adenoma recurrence, 1st sampling) |
| Re2   | Recurrence_2 (adenoma recurrence, 2nd sampling) |
| Non1  | Non_recurrence_1 (adenoma non-recurrence, 1st sampling) |
| Non2  | Non_recurrence_2 (adenoma non-recurrence, 2nd sampling) |
| CRC   | CRC |

The main analysis is the **4-group adenoma follow-up subset** (Re1 / Re2 /
Non1 / Non2, n = 236 samples, 59 per group): do predicted microbial
phenotypes differ by recurrence status or change between samplings?

## 1.2 Phenotype-prediction tools

| Tool | Prediction | Output |
|------|------------|--------|
| **Traitar** | 67 classical microbial phenotypes | per-MAG trait calls -> per-sample proportion / coverage-weighted prevalence |
| **microTrait** | Hierarchical life-history traits | per-MAG binary trait calls -> per-sample proportion / coverage-weighted score |
| **dbCAN3** | CAZyme families (GH / GT / PL / CE / AA / CBM) | per-MAG CAZyme counts -> per-sample proportion / score / present-count |

All tools use the same annotated-table format
(`SID, profile_column, source, <features...>`), so the same downstream
visualisation framework is reused.

## 1.3 Statistical methods

- **Aitchison distance** (CLR + Euclidean) for compositional proportion data;
  zeros handled by multiplicative replacement.
- **PERMANOVA** (`adonis2`, 999 permutations) + `betadisper` + PCoA with 68%
  confidence ellipses.
- **Kruskal-Wallis global test** (not pairwise Wilcoxon) for 6-group and
  4-group comparisons, with BH-FDR correction.
- **Effect sizes**: max - min group median (or mean) per trait.
- **dbCAN3**: ALDEx2 Monte Carlo CLR (128 Dirichlet samples, Kruskal-Wallis)
  when installed, with Kruskal-Wallis + BH fallback.
- **Targeted mucin modules**: curated CAZyme families collapsed into four
  biologically-motivated modules.
# 2. Traitar

## 2.1 Overview

Traitar predicts 67 classical microbial phenotypes from MAGs. Per-sample trait
proportion and coverage-weighted prevalence are compared across the 6 clinical
groups and the 4-group adenoma follow-up subset.

**Key results (4-group subset):** no trait survives BH-FDR (best p = 0.0099,
padj = 0.652); largest effect is Trehalose utilization (0.088); PERMANOVA
shows no separation (4-group R2 = 0.012, P = 0.523; 6-group R2 = 0.013,
P = 0.448).
## 2.2 Script

**Script:** targetc_traitar_plot_02.R

```r
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ==============================================================================
# TargetC Traitar Phenotype Visualization (Publication Quality)
# ==============================================================================
# Groups (6):
#   N    -> Normal
#   Re1  -> Recurrence_1   (adenoma recurrence, 1st sampling)
#   Re2  -> Recurrence_2   (adenoma recurrence, 2nd sampling)
#   Non1 -> Non_recurrence_1 (adenoma non-recurrence, 1st sampling)
#   Non2 -> Non_recurrence_2 (adenoma non-recurrence, 2nd sampling)
#   CRC  -> CRC
#   (8 samples with empty source are excluded)
#
# Key methodology:
#   - Aitchison distance (CLR + Euclidean) for compositional data, NOT Bray-Curtis
#   - PERMANOVA preceded by betadisper test for homogeneity of dispersion
#   - Kruskal-Wallis global test (not pairwise Wilcoxon) for group comparisons
#   - Symmetric error bars: mean +/- SE
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cowplot)
  library(scales)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(vegan)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 0. Paths and parameters
# ==============================================================================
RESULT_DIR <- "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/enhanced/Results"
ANNOTATED_DIR <- file.path(RESULT_DIR, "trait_summary_annotated_mimag90_fixed")
OUTPUT_DIR <- "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/enhanced/Results/traitar_plot_02"
FOUR_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "traitar_4")
if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(FOUR_DIR)) dir.create(FOUR_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

PROP_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_trait_proportion_coverage.tsv")
WMEAN_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_trait_wmean_coverage.tsv")
COUNT_FILE   <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_trait_present_count.tsv")

# Trait category definitions
TRAIT_CATEGORIES <- list(
  `Carbohydrate utilization` = c(
    "Gas from glucose", "Glucose fermenter", "Glucose oxidizer",
    "Cellobiose", "D-Mannitol", "D-Mannose", "D-Sorbitol", "D-Xylose",
    "Glycerol", "Lactose", "L-Arabinose", "L-Rhamnose", "Maltose",
    "Melibiose", "myo-Inositol", "ONPG (beta galactosidase)", "Raffinose",
    "Salicin", "Sucrose", "Trehalose", "Esculin hydrolysis",
    "Methyl red", "Voges Proskauer"
  ),
  `Nitrogen metabolism` = c(
    "Nitrate to nitrite", "Nitrite to gas",
    "Arginine dihydrolase", "Urea hydrolysis", "Indole",
    "Lysine decarboxylase", "Ornithine decarboxylase"
  ),
  `Enzyme activity` = c(
    "Alkaline phosphatase", "Catalase", "Oxidase",
    "DNase", "Lipase", "Coagulase production",
    "Hydrogen sulfide", "Casein hydrolysis", "Gelatin hydrolysis",
    "Starch hydrolysis"
  ),
  `Oxygen requirement` = c(
    "Aerobe", "Anaerobe", "Capnophilic", "Facultative"
  ),
  `Morphology & Gram stain` = c(
    "Gram negative", "Gram positive",
    "Bacillus or coccobacillus", "Coccus",
    "Coccus - clusters or groups predominate",
    "Coccus - pairs or chains predominate",
    "Motile", "Spore formation", "Yellow pigment"
  ),
  `Growth conditions` = c(
    "Growth at 42°C", "Growth in 6.5% NaCl", "Growth in KCN",
    "Growth on MacConkey agar", "Growth on ordinary blood agar",
    "Bile-susceptible", "Colistin-Polymyxin susceptible"
  ),
  `Biochemical tests` = c(
    "Citrate", "Malonate", "Tartrate utilization",
    "Acetate utilization", "Mucate utilization",
    "Pyrrolidonyl-beta-naphthylamide", "Beta hemolysis"
  )
)

ALL_DEFINED_TRAITS <- unlist(TRAIT_CATEGORIES, use.names = FALSE)

# Group mapping and levels
GROUP_LABELS <- c("N" = "Normal", "Re1" = "Recurrence_1", "Re2" = "Recurrence_2",
                   "Non1" = "Non_recurrence_1", "Non2" = "Non_recurrence_2", "CRC" = "CRC")
GROUP_LEVELS <- unname(GROUP_LABELS)
FOUR_LEVELS <- c("Recurrence_1", "Recurrence_2", "Non_recurrence_1", "Non_recurrence_2")

GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "Normal" = "#00A087", "Recurrence_1" = "#E64B35", "Recurrence_2" = "#F39B7F",
  "Non_recurrence_1" = "#4DBBD5", "Non_recurrence_2" = "#91D1C2", "CRC" = "#3C5488"
)
FOUR_COLORS <- c(
  "Recurrence_1" = "#E64B35", "Recurrence_2" = "#F39B7F",
  "Non_recurrence_1" = "#4DBBD5", "Non_recurrence_2" = "#91D1C2"
)

CAT_COLORS <- c(
  `Carbohydrate utilization` = "#E64B35", `Nitrogen metabolism` = "#4DBBD5",
  `Enzyme activity` = "#00A087", `Oxygen requirement` = "#3C5488",
  `Morphology & Gram stain` = "#F39B7F", `Growth conditions` = "#8491B4",
  `Biochemical tests` = "#91D1C2", `Other` = "#CCCCCC"
)

# ==============================================================================
# Theme & helpers
# ==============================================================================
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 14) {
  theme_cowplot(base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = base_size, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", color = "grey30"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 4, b = 4)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black", linewidth = 1),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size + 1, face = "bold"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey85", linetype = "dashed"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "cm")
    )
}

# Map raw source values to display Group factor
to_group <- function(src, levels = GROUP_LEVELS) {
  mapped <- GROUP_LABELS[as.character(src)]
  mapped[is.na(mapped)] <- NA_character_
  factor(mapped, levels = levels)
}

# CLR transform with zero handling (multiplicative replacement via pseudocount)
clr_transform <- function(mat) {
  # Replace zeros with half the minimum non-zero value per row (standard pseudocount)
  mat_out <- mat
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(mat_out))) {
    row_vals <- mat_out[i, ]
    min_pos <- min(row_vals[row_vals > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    mat_out[i, row_vals == 0] <- min_pos / 2
  }
  # CLR: log-ratio transform
  gm <- apply(mat_out, 1, function(x) exp(mean(log(x))))
  log(mat_out / gm)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Read and prepare data
# ==============================================================================
cat("==============================================================\n")
cat(" TargetC Traitar Phenotype Visualization\n")
cat("==============================================================\n\n")

cat("Reading data files...\n")
prop_cov <- read.delim(PROP_COV_FILE, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
wmean_cov <- read.delim(WMEAN_COV_FILE, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
present_count <- read.delim(COUNT_FILE, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("  Proportion coverage: %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(prop_cov), ncol(prop_cov)))
cat(sprintf("  Weighted mean prevalence: %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(wmean_cov), ncol(wmean_cov)))
cat(sprintf("  Present count: %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(present_count), ncol(present_count)))

meta_cols <- c("SID", "profile_column", "source")

# Exclude empty/NA source rows
prop_cov <- prop_cov %>% filter(!is.na(source) & source != "")
wmean_cov <- wmean_cov %>% filter(!is.na(source) & source != "")
present_count <- present_count %>% filter(!is.na(source) & source != "")

# Exclude samples where ALL trait columns are NA (samples without Traitar data)
# These come from the left join in script 09 — they have no trait predictions
prop_cov$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(prop_cov)))
wmean_cov$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(wmean_cov)))
present_count$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(present_count)))

# Trait columns (only defined categories)
# Use proportion data for heatmaps and Aitchison PCoA (compositional, rows sum to 1)
trait_cols <- intersect(setdiff(colnames(prop_cov), c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group")), ALL_DEFINED_TRAITS)
# Use weighted mean prevalence for KW tests, boxplots, and per-trait comparisons (independent across traits)
trait_cols_wmean <- intersect(setdiff(colnames(wmean_cov), c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group")), ALL_DEFINED_TRAITS)
trait_cols_count <- intersect(setdiff(colnames(present_count), c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group")), ALL_DEFINED_TRAITS)

# Identify and remove samples with all-NA trait data (Traitar failures)
n_prop_all_na <- sum(rowSums(is.na(prop_cov[, trait_cols, drop = FALSE])) == length(trait_cols))
n_wmean_all_na <- sum(rowSums(is.na(wmean_cov[, trait_cols_wmean, drop = FALSE])) == length(trait_cols_wmean))
n_count_all_na <- sum(rowSums(is.na(present_count[, trait_cols_count, drop = FALSE])) == length(trait_cols_count))
if (n_prop_all_na > 0) cat(sprintf("  Note: Removing %d samples with all-NA trait data from proportion\n", n_prop_all_na))
if (n_wmean_all_na > 0) cat(sprintf("  Note: Removing %d samples with all-NA trait data from wmean\n", n_wmean_all_na))
if (n_count_all_na > 0) cat(sprintf("  Note: Removing %d samples with all-NA trait data from count\n", n_count_all_na))

prop_cov <- prop_cov %>% filter(rowSums(is.na(.[, trait_cols, drop = FALSE])) < length(trait_cols))
wmean_cov <- wmean_cov %>% filter(rowSums(is.na(.[, trait_cols_wmean, drop = FALSE])) < length(trait_cols_wmean))
present_count <- present_count %>% filter(rowSums(is.na(.[, trait_cols_count, drop = FALSE])) < length(trait_cols_count))

# For remaining rows with partial NA, fill with 0 (Traitar predicted absent for that trait)
prop_cov[, trait_cols] <- lapply(prop_cov[, trait_cols, drop = FALSE], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
wmean_cov[, trait_cols_wmean] <- lapply(wmean_cov[, trait_cols_wmean, drop = FALSE], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
present_count[, trait_cols_count] <- lapply(present_count[, trait_cols_count, drop = FALSE], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))

# Re-assign row_ids after filtering
prop_cov$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(prop_cov)))
wmean_cov$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(wmean_cov)))
present_count$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(present_count)))

# Add Group display label
prop_cov$Group <- to_group(prop_cov$source)
wmean_cov$Group <- to_group(wmean_cov$source)
present_count$Group <- to_group(present_count$source)

dropped <- setdiff(setdiff(colnames(prop_cov), c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group")), trait_cols)
if (length(dropped) > 0) cat(sprintf("  Note: %d data traits not in category defs (excluded): %s\n",
                                       length(dropped), paste(head(dropped, 5), collapse = ", ")))

cat(sprintf("  Trait columns used (proportion): %d\n", length(trait_cols)))
cat(sprintf("  Trait columns used (wmean): %d\n", length(trait_cols_wmean)))
cat(sprintf("  Final sample counts: prop=%d, wmean=%d, count=%d\n", nrow(prop_cov), nrow(wmean_cov), nrow(present_count)))

# Long format: proportion (for Aitchison PCoA and heatmaps)
prop_long <- prop_cov %>%
  select(all_of(c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group", trait_cols))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(trait_cols), names_to = "trait", values_to = "proportion") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group))

# Long format: weighted mean prevalence (for KW tests, boxplots, per-trait comparisons)
wmean_long <- wmean_cov %>%
  select(all_of(c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group", trait_cols_wmean))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(trait_cols_wmean), names_to = "trait", values_to = "wmean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group))

trait_cat_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(TRAIT_CATEGORIES), function(cat) {
  data.frame(trait = TRAIT_CATEGORIES[[cat]], category = cat, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
prop_long <- prop_long %>% left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>% filter(!is.na(category))
wmean_long <- wmean_long %>% left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>% filter(!is.na(category))

group_sizes <- prop_cov %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>% group_by(Group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(Group)
cat("\nGroup sizes:\n"); print(group_sizes)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Figure 1: Heatmap (6 groups)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 1: Phenotype heatmap...\n")

heatmap_data <- prop_cov %>%
  select(all_of(c("row_id", trait_cols))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("row_id") %>% as.matrix()

group_anno <- prop_cov %>% select(row_id, Group) %>%
  column_to_rownames("row_id") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS))

# Remove zero-variance traits for scale="row"
trait_vars_hm <- apply(heatmap_data, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
valid_hm <- names(trait_vars_hm)[!is.na(trait_vars_hm) & trait_vars_hm > 0]
top_traits <- names(sort(trait_vars_hm[valid_hm], decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(40, length(valid_hm))]

heatmap_mat <- t(heatmap_data[, top_traits, drop = FALSE])

cat_anno <- data.frame(trait = rownames(heatmap_mat), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>% filter(!is.na(category))
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[cat_anno$trait, , drop = FALSE]
rownames(cat_anno) <- cat_anno$trait; cat_anno$trait <- NULL

anno_colors <- list(Group = GROUP_COLORS[GROUP_LEVELS],
                    category = CAT_COLORS[unique(cat_anno$category)])

pheatmap(heatmap_mat, scale = "row", cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE, show_rownames = TRUE, fontsize_row = 8, fontsize_col = 9,
  annotation_col = group_anno, annotation_row = cat_anno, annotation_colors = anno_colors,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")))(100), border_color = NA,
  main = "Top Variable Phenotypes (All 6 Groups)",
  filename = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig1_phenotype_heatmap.png"), width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# 4-group heatmap
heatmap_data_4 <- prop_cov %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS) %>%
  select(all_of(c("row_id", trait_cols))) %>%
  column_to_rownames("row_id") %>% as.matrix()
group_anno_4 <- prop_cov %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS) %>%
  select(row_id, Group) %>% column_to_rownames("row_id") %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = FOUR_LEVELS))

tv4 <- apply(heatmap_data_4, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
valid4 <- names(tv4)[!is.na(tv4) & tv4 > 0]
top4 <- names(sort(tv4[valid4], decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(40, length(valid4))]
hm4 <- t(heatmap_data_4[, top4, drop = FALSE])
ca4 <- data.frame(trait = rownames(hm4), stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>% filter(!is.na(category))
hm4 <- hm4[ca4$trait, , drop = FALSE]; rownames(ca4) <- ca4$trait; ca4$trait <- NULL

pheatmap(hm4, scale = "row", cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE, show_rownames = TRUE, fontsize_row = 8, fontsize_col = 9,
  annotation_col = group_anno_4, annotation_row = ca4,
  annotation_colors = list(Group = FOUR_COLORS[FOUR_LEVELS], category = CAT_COLORS[unique(ca4$category)]),
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")))(100), border_color = NA,
  main = "Top Variable Phenotypes (Adenoma Follow-up)",
  filename = file.path(FOUR_DIR, "fig1_phenotype_heatmap.png"), width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Figure 2: Category boxplots (KW global test)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 2: Category boxplots...\n")

cat_prop <- wmean_long %>%
  group_by(row_id, Group, category) %>%
  summarise(cat_wmean = sum(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = names(TRAIT_CATEGORIES)))

cat_prop_4 <- cat_prop %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = FOUR_LEVELS))

plot_cat_box <- function(df, grp_lvls, colors, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = cat_wmean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, aes(color = Group)) +
    facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.signif", size = 3.5,
                      label.y.npc = "top", label.x.npc = "left") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Group", y = "Weighted mean prevalence") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 8),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}

p2 <- plot_cat_box(cat_prop, GROUP_LEVELS, GROUP_COLORS, "Phenotype Category Proportions")
p2_4 <- plot_cat_box(cat_prop_4, FOUR_LEVELS, FOUR_COLORS, "Phenotype Category (Adenoma Follow-up)")
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig2_category_boxplots.png"), p2, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(FOUR_DIR, "fig2_category_boxplots.png"), p2_4, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Figure 3: Key traits boxplots (KW global test)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 3: Key traits boxplots...\n")

key_traits <- intersect(c("Aerobe", "Anaerobe", "Facultative",
  "Gram negative", "Gram positive", "Motile", "Spore formation",
  "Catalase", "Oxidase", "Urea hydrolysis",
  "Growth at 42°C", "Growth in 6.5% NaCl", "Bile-susceptible",
  "Glucose fermenter", "Lactose", "Sucrose",
  "Nitrate to nitrite", "Indole", "Colistin-Polymyxin susceptible"), trait_cols)

plot_key_box <- function(df, grp_lvls, colors, title) {
  df_f <- df %>% filter(trait %in% key_traits) %>%
    mutate(trait = factor(trait, levels = key_traits))
  ggplot(df_f, aes(x = Group, y = wmean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6, aes(color = Group)) +
    facet_wrap(~trait, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.signif", size = 3,
                      label.y.npc = "top", label.x.npc = "left") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Group", y = "Weighted mean prevalence") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 7),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}

p3 <- plot_key_box(wmean_long, GROUP_LEVELS, GROUP_COLORS, "Key Phenotype Weighted Mean Prevalence")
p3_4 <- plot_key_box(wmean_long %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS) %>% mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = FOUR_LEVELS)),
                     FOUR_LEVELS, FOUR_COLORS, "Key Phenotypes (Adenoma Follow-up)")
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig3_key_traits_boxplots.png"), p3, width = 14, height = 11, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(FOUR_DIR, "fig3_key_traits_boxplots.png"), p3_4, width = 14, height = 11, dpi = 300)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Figure 4: Prevalence heatmap
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 4: Trait prevalence heatmap...\n")

write_prevalence_hm <- function(pcount, tcols, grp_lvls, colors, fname, width) {
  prev <- pcount %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    select(all_of(c("Group", tcols))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(tcols), names_to = "trait", values_to = "count") %>%
    mutate(present = count > 0) %>%
    group_by(Group, trait) %>%
    summarise(n_total = n(), n_present = sum(present), prevalence = n_present / n_total * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls))

  pw <- prev %>% select(Group, trait, prevalence) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = prevalence, values_fn = mean) %>%
    column_to_rownames("trait") %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

  pw <- pw %>% rownames_to_column("trait") %>% left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>%
    mutate(category = ifelse(is.na(category), "Other", category)) %>%
    arrange(category, desc(!!sym(grp_lvls[1]))) %>% select(-category) %>%
    column_to_rownames("trait") %>% as.matrix()

  pheatmap(pw, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE, fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 8,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B"))(100),
    border_color = "grey80", main = "Trait Prevalence (% samples with trait)",
    breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
    filename = fname, width = width, height = 12, dpi = 300)
}

write_prevalence_hm(present_count, trait_cols_count, GROUP_LEVELS, GROUP_COLORS,
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig4_trait_prevalence_heatmap.png"), width = 6)
write_prevalence_hm(present_count %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS),
  trait_cols_count, FOUR_LEVELS, FOUR_COLORS,
  file.path(FOUR_DIR, "fig4_trait_prevalence_heatmap.png"), width = 5)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Figure 5: Aitchison PCoA + PERMANOVA (with betadisper test)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 5: Aitchison PCoA + PERMANOVA...\n")

make_pcoa <- function(pcov_df, grp_lvls, colors, title_str, out_file) {
  df <- pcov_df %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls))

  mat <- df %>% select(all_of(c("row_id", trait_cols))) %>%
    column_to_rownames("row_id") %>% as.matrix()

  # Remove zero-variance columns
  tv <- apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  mat <- mat[, tv > 0]

  # CLR transform (handles zeros with pseudocount)
  clr_mat <- clr_transform(mat)

  # Euclidean distance on CLR = Aitchison distance
  dist_mat <- dist(clr_mat, method = "euclidean")

  # PCoA via cmdscale
  pcoa_res <- cmdscale(dist_mat, k = min(2, nrow(clr_mat) - 1), eig = TRUE)

  # Variance explained (positive eigenvalues only)
  pos_eig <- pcoa_res$eig[pcoa_res$eig > 0]
  var_exp <- round(pos_eig[1:min(2, length(pos_eig))] / sum(pos_eig) * 100, 1)

  scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
  colnames(scores) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")[1:ncol(scores)]
  scores$row_id <- rownames(scores)

  rid_grp <- df %>% select(row_id, Group) %>% distinct()
  scores <- scores %>% left_join(rid_grp, by = "row_id")
  scores$Group <- factor(scores$Group, levels = grp_lvls)

  # PERMANOVA (adonis2)
  grp_vec <- scores$Group[match(labels(dist_mat), scores$row_id)]
  set.seed(42)
  adonis_res <- adonis2(dist_mat ~ grp_vec, permutations = 999)
  p_val <- adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  r2 <- round(adonis_res$R2[1], 3)

  # Betadisper test (homogeneity of dispersion)
  beta_disp <- betadisper(dist_mat, grp_vec)
  beta_p <- anova(beta_disp)$`Pr(>F)`[1]

  cat(sprintf("  PERMANOVA: R2=%.3f, p=%.4f | Betadisper p=%.4f\n", r2, p_val, beta_p))

  centroids <- scores %>% group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(PCoA1 = mean(PCoA1), PCoA2 = mean(PCoA2), .groups = "drop")

  subtitle <- bquote("PERMANOVA: " ~ R^2 == .(r2) ~ ", p" == .(format.pval(p_val, digits = 3)) ~
    " | Dispersion p" == .(format.pval(beta_p, digits = 3)))

  p <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Group, fill = Group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_point(data = centroids, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2), shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1.5, color = "black") +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    labs(title = title_str, subtitle = subtitle,
         x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
         y = if(ncol(scores) >= 2) sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2]) else "PCoA2",
         fill = "Group", color = "Group") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  list(scores = scores, adonis_r2 = r2, adonis_p = p_val, betadisper_p = beta_p)
}

  "Aitchison PCoA (All 6 Groups)", file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig5_pcoa_phenotype.png"))
res_4 <- make_pcoa(prop_cov %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS), FOUR_LEVELS, FOUR_COLORS,

# ==============================================================================
# 7. Figure 6: Differential analysis (KW + volcano)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 6: Differential phenotype analysis...\n")

make_kw_volcano <- function(long_df, title_str, out_file) {
  kw_res <- long_df %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(kw_stat = kruskal.test(wmean ~ Group)$statistic,
              kw_pval = kruskal.test(wmean ~ Group)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(kw_padj = p.adjust(kw_pval, method = "BH"),
           neg_log10_padj = -log10(kw_padj)) %>%
    left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>% arrange(kw_padj)
  kw_res$category[is.na(kw_res$category)] <- "Other"

  grp_med <- long_df %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    group_by(trait, Group) %>% summarise(med = median(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  eff <- grp_med %>% group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(effect_size = max(med) - min(med), .groups = "drop")

  kw_volc <- kw_res %>% left_join(eff, by = "trait") %>%
    mutate(category = factor(category, levels = c(names(TRAIT_CATEGORIES), "Other")))
  sig <- kw_volc %>% filter(kw_padj < 0.05) %>% slice_max(order_by = neg_log10_padj, n = 15)

  p <- ggplot(kw_volc, aes(x = effect_size, y = neg_log10_padj, color = category)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = CAT_COLORS) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = sig, aes(label = trait), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20,
      box.padding = 0.4, segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3) +
    labs(title = title_str,
         x = "Effect Size (max - min group median)", y = expression(-log[10](adj.~p)), color = "Category") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 12)

  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 8, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
  kw_res
}

  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig6_differential_phenotype.png"))

plot_morph <- function(long_df, grp_lvls, colors, title, out_file) {
  df <- long_df %>% filter(trait %in% gram_traits, !is.na(Group)) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls)) %>%
    group_by(Group, trait) %>%
    summarise(mean_wmean = mean(wmean, na.rm = TRUE),
              se = sd(wmean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = mean_wmean, fill = trait)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_wmean - se), ymax = mean_wmean + se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Trait") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Group", y = "Weighted mean prevalence +/- SE") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
}

# 11. Figure 10: Cleveland dot plot (all traits)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 10: All traits dot plot...\n")

plot_dotplot <- function(long_df, grp_lvls, colors, title, out_file) {
  df <- long_df %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    group_by(Group, category, trait) %>%
    summarise(mean_wmean = mean(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(category = factor(category, levels = names(TRAIT_CATEGORIES)),
           trait = reorder(trait, mean_wmean, FUN = mean))
  global_max <- max(df$mean_wmean, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

  ggplot(df, aes(x = mean_wmean, y = trait, color = Group)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = global_max, y = trait, yend = trait),
                 color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.5) +
    facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls], name = "Group") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Mean Weighted Prevalence (coverage-weighted)", y = NULL) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 10) +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 8, face = "bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"))
}

  group_by(Group, category) %>%
  summarise(mean_wmean = mean(cat_wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = mean_wmean) %>%
  arrange(match(Group, GROUP_LEVELS))
save_csv(cat_wide, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "table11_group_category_mean_matrix.csv"))

cat_wide_4 <- cat_prop %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group), Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = FOUR_LEVELS)) %>%
  group_by(Group, category) %>%
  summarise(mean_wmean = mean(cat_wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = mean_wmean) %>%
  arrange(Group)
save_csv(cat_wide_4, file.path(FOUR_DIR, "table11_group_category_mean_matrix_4adenoma.csv"))

cat("\n==============================================================\n")
cat(" Visualization Complete!\n")
```

## 2.3 Results

**Kruskal-Wallis, 4-group adenoma subset (top raw-p traits):**

| Trait | Category | kw_stat | p | padj |
|-------|----------|---------|---|------|
| Acetate utilization | Biochemical tests | 11.37 | 0.0099 | 0.652 |
| Anaerobe | Oxygen requirement | 6.16 | 0.104 | 0.913 |
| (all other traits) | — | — | — | 0.913 |

**Kruskal-Wallis, 6 groups (top raw-p traits):**

| Trait | Category | kw_stat | p | padj |
|-------|----------|---------|---|------|
| Beta hemolysis | Biochemical tests | 14.92 | 0.0107 | 0.708 |
| Acetate utilization | Biochemical tests | 12.28 | 0.0311 | 0.878 |
| Anaerobe | Oxygen requirement | 11.31 | 0.0457 | 0.878 |

**Effect sizes, 4-group (max − min group mean):**

| Trait | Effect size | Group max | Group min |
|-------|------------|-----------|-----------|
| Trehalose | 0.088 | Recurrence_2 | Non_recurrence_1 |
| Alkaline phosphatase | 0.085 | Recurrence_2 | Non_recurrence_1 |
| Bile-susceptible | 0.081 | Recurrence_1 | Non_recurrence_2 |

**PERMANOVA + betadisper:**

| Comparison | n | R² | PERMANOVA p | Betadisper p |
|------------|---|----|-------------|--------------|
| All 6 groups | 382 | 0.013 | 0.448 | 0.043 |
| Adenoma follow-up (4 groups) | 236 | 0.012 | 0.523 | 0.712 |

proportions). Columns are samples annotated by group; rows are the 40 most

**Figure 3.** Differential-phenotype volcano (Kruskal-Wallis, x = effect size,
y = −log10 adjusted p). No trait crosses the FDR < 0.05 threshold.

## 2.5 Interpretation

1. **No Traitar phenotype is significant** after BH-FDR; the predicted
   classical phenotypes are stable across recurrence status and sampling time.
2. Effect sizes are small (0.08-0.09) and directionally inconsistent.
3. The only marginal signal is 6-group betadisper (P = 0.043), a dispersion
   effect driven by CRC, not a location shift.
# 3. microTrait

## 3.1 Overview

microTrait predicts hierarchical life-history traits from MAGs.
Coverage-weighted scores are used for per-trait tests; compositional
proportions are used for multivariate analysis.

**Key results (4-group subset):** no trait survives BH-FDR (all padj = 0.357;
best raw p = 0.0115 for polysaccharide transport); largest effect size
(protein degradation, 5939.6) is coverage-driven; PERMANOVA shows no
separation (4-group R2 = 0.014, P = 0.266; 6-group R2 = 0.015, P = 0.201).
## 3.2 Script

**Script:** targetc_micotrait_plot.R

```r
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ==============================================================================
# TargetC microTrait Phenotype Visualization (Nature-quality)
# ==============================================================================
# Groups (6):
#   N    -> Normal                       (endoscopy-normal control)
#   Re1  -> Recurrence_1                 (adenoma recurrence, 1st sampling)
#   Re2  -> Recurrence_2                 (adenoma recurrence, 2nd sampling)
#   Non1 -> Non_recurrence_1             (adenoma non-recurrence, 1st sampling)
#   Non2 -> Non_recurrence_2             (adenoma non-recurrence, 2nd sampling)
#   CRC  -> CRC
#   (samples with empty source are excluded)
#
# Input  : trait_summary_annotated_mimag90  (output of Step 09 annotate)
#   annotated_binary_sample_trait_proportion_coverage.tsv  compositional (PCoA, heatmap)
#   annotated_binary_sample_trait_score_coverage.tsv       coverage-weighted score (KW, boxplots)
#   annotated_binary_sample_trait_present_count.tsv        MAG count carrying trait (prevalence)
#   annotated_continuous_sample_continuous_summary.tsv     continuous traits (genome size, growth, OGT)
#
# Output : microtrait-plot/        6-group figures + CSV tables
#          microtrait-plot/plot-4/ 4-group (adenoma follow-up) figures + CSV tables
#
# Methodology:
#   - Aitchison distance (CLR + Euclidean) for compositional proportion data, NOT Bray-Curtis
#   - PERMANOVA preceded by betadisper test for homogeneity of dispersion
#   - Kruskal-Wallis global test (not pairwise Wilcoxon) for group comparisons
#   - Error bars: mean +/- SE
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cowplot)
  library(scales)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(vegan)
  library(ggrepel)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 0. Paths and parameters
# ==============================================================================
ANNOTATED_DIR <- Sys.getenv(
  "TARGETC_MICROTRAIT_ANNOTATED_DIR",
  "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/phenotypes-analysis/microtrait-analysis/results/trait_summary_annotated_mimag90")
OUTPUT_DIR <- Sys.getenv(
  "TARGETC_MICROTRAIT_PLOT_DIR",
  "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/phenotypes-analysis/microtrait-analysis/results/microtrait-plot")
FOUR_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot-4")
if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(FOUR_DIR)) dir.create(FOUR_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

PROP_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_binary_sample_trait_proportion_coverage.tsv")
WMEAN_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_binary_sample_trait_score_coverage.tsv")
COUNT_FILE    <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_binary_sample_trait_present_count.tsv")
CONT_FILE     <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_continuous_sample_continuous_summary.tsv")

# ---- Group mapping: source -> Group display labels ----
GROUP_LABELS <- c("N" = "Normal", "Re1" = "Recurrence_1", "Re2" = "Recurrence_2",
                  "Non1" = "Non_recurrence_1", "Non2" = "Non_recurrence_2", "CRC" = "CRC")
GROUP_LEVELS <- unname(GROUP_LABELS)
FOUR_LEVELS  <- c("Recurrence_1", "Recurrence_2", "Non_recurrence_1", "Non_recurrence_2")

# Nature-style palette (matched to the NPG/nejm schemes used by ggpubr)
GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "Normal" = "#00A087", "Recurrence_1" = "#E64B35", "Recurrence_2" = "#F39B7F",
  "Non_recurrence_1" = "#4DBBD5", "Non_recurrence_2" = "#91D1C2", "CRC" = "#3C5488")
FOUR_COLORS <- c(
  "Recurrence_1" = "#E64B35", "Recurrence_2" = "#F39B7F",
  "Non_recurrence_1" = "#4DBBD5", "Non_recurrence_2" = "#91D1C2")

SUPER_COLORS <- c(
  "Resource Acquisition" = "#E64B35", "Resource Use" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Stress Tolerance" = "#3C5488")

CATEGORY_COLORS <- c(
  "Substrate uptake" = "#E64B35", "Substrate degradation" = "#F39B7F",
  "Substrate assimilation" = "#00A087", "Chemotrophy" = "#4DBBD5",
  "Phototrophy" = "#91D1C2", "General" = "#3C5488", "Specific" = "#8491B4")

CONT_COLORS <- c(
  "Genome length (Mb)" = "#00A087",
  "Minimum generation time (h)" = "#E64B35",
  "Optimal growth temperature (°C)" = "#3C5488")

# ==============================================================================
# Theme & helpers
# ==============================================================================
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 15) {
  theme_cowplot(base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = base_size, color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 3, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 1, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", color = "grey30"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black", linewidth = 1),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey85", linetype = "dashed"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.65, "cm")
    )
}

# Map raw source values to display Group factor
to_group <- function(src, levels = GROUP_LEVELS) {
  mapped <- GROUP_LABELS[as.character(src)]
  mapped[is.na(mapped)] <- NA_character_
  factor(mapped, levels = levels)
}

# microTrait traits are hierarchical, colon-separated: "Top:Mid:Leaf:..."
parse_trait_categories <- function(trait_names) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(trait_names, function(t) {
    parts <- strsplit(t, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    data.frame(
      trait = t,
      super_category = parts[1],
      category = if (length(parts) >= 2) paste(parts[1], parts[2], sep = " > ") else parts[1],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}

display_trait <- function(t) gsub(":", " / ", t, fixed = TRUE)
short_category <- function(c) sub("^.* > ", "", c)
wrap_label <- function(x, width = 26) {
  vapply(as.character(x), function(s) paste(strwrap(s, width = width), collapse = "\n"),
         character(1))
}

# CLR transform with zero handling (multiplicative replacement via pseudocount)
clr_transform <- function(mat) {
  mat_out <- mat
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(mat_out))) {
    row_vals <- mat_out[i, ]
    min_pos <- min(row_vals[row_vals > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(min_pos)) mat_out[i, row_vals == 0] <- min_pos / 2
  }
  gm <- apply(mat_out, 1, function(x) exp(mean(log(x))))
  log(mat_out / gm)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 1. Read and prepare data
# ==============================================================================
cat("==============================================================\n")
cat(" TargetC microTrait Phenotype Visualization\n")
cat("==============================================================\n\n")

cat("Reading data files...\n")
prop_cov <- read.delim(PROP_COV_FILE, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
wmean_cov <- read.delim(WMEAN_COV_FILE, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
present_count <- read.delim(COUNT_FILE, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
cont_sum <- read.delim(CONT_FILE, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("  Proportion coverage: %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(prop_cov), ncol(prop_cov)))
cat(sprintf("  Score coverage:      %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(wmean_cov), ncol(wmean_cov)))
cat(sprintf("  Present count:       %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(present_count), ncol(present_count)))
cat(sprintf("  Continuous summary:  %d rows x %d cols\n", nrow(cont_sum), ncol(cont_sum)))

meta_cols <- c("SID", "profile_column", "source", "sample_id")

# Exclude empty/NA source rows
prop_cov <- prop_cov %>% filter(!is.na(source) & source != "")
wmean_cov <- wmean_cov %>% filter(!is.na(source) & source != "")
present_count <- present_count %>% filter(!is.na(source) & source != "")
cont_sum <- cont_sum %>% filter(!is.na(source) & source != "")

prop_cov$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(prop_cov)))
wmean_cov$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(wmean_cov)))
present_count$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(present_count)))

trait_cols <- setdiff(colnames(prop_cov), c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group"))
trait_cols_wmean <- setdiff(colnames(wmean_cov), c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group"))
trait_cols_count <- setdiff(colnames(present_count), c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group"))

stopifnot(identical(trait_cols, trait_cols_wmean),
          identical(trait_cols, trait_cols_count))

# Remove samples where ALL trait columns are NA (no microTrait predictions), then
# fill any partial NA with 0 (trait predicted absent).
filter_allna <- function(df, tcols) {
  n_na <- sum(rowSums(is.na(df[, tcols, drop = FALSE])) == length(tcols))
  if (n_na > 0) cat(sprintf("  Note: Removing %d samples with all-NA trait data\n", n_na))
  df <- df %>% filter(rowSums(is.na(.[, tcols, drop = FALSE])) < length(tcols))
  df[, tcols] <- lapply(df[, tcols, drop = FALSE], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
  df$row_id <- paste0("row_", seq_len(nrow(df)))
  df
}
prop_cov <- filter_allna(prop_cov, trait_cols)
wmean_cov <- filter_allna(wmean_cov, trait_cols_wmean)
present_count <- filter_allna(present_count, trait_cols_count)

# Add Group display label
prop_cov$Group <- to_group(prop_cov$source)
wmean_cov$Group <- to_group(wmean_cov$source)
present_count$Group <- to_group(present_count$source)
cont_sum$Group <- to_group(cont_sum$source)

# Trait category annotation (derived from the hierarchical trait names)
trait_cat_df <- parse_trait_categories(trait_cols)
trait_cat_df$category <- factor(trait_cat_df$category,
                                levels = unique(trait_cat_df$category))
trait_cat_df$super_category <- factor(trait_cat_df$super_category,
                                      levels = names(SUPER_COLORS))
cat(sprintf("  %d traits; %d super-categories; %d categories\n",
            nrow(trait_cat_df), nlevels(trait_cat_df$super_category), nlevels(trait_cat_df$category)))

# Long format: coverage-weighted score (independent across traits; KW, boxplots, dotplot)
wmean_long <- wmean_cov %>%
  select(all_of(c(meta_cols, "row_id", "Group", trait_cols_wmean))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(trait_cols_wmean), names_to = "trait", values_to = "wmean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait")

# Long format: continuous traits (genome size / growth / OGT)
cont_long <- cont_sum %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  mutate(`Genome length (Mb)` = genome_length_wmean_coverage / 1e6,
         `Minimum generation time (h)` = mingentime_wmean_coverage,
         `Optimal growth temperature (°C)` = optimumT_wmean_coverage) %>%
  select(Group, `Genome length (Mb)`, `Minimum generation time (h)`,
         `Optimal growth temperature (°C)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Group, names_to = "ctrait", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(ctrait = factor(ctrait, levels = names(CONT_COLORS)))

group_sizes <- prop_cov %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>% group_by(Group) %>% summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(Group)
cat("\nGroup sizes:\n"); print(group_sizes)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Figure 1: Top-variable phenotype heatmap
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 1: Phenotype heatmap...\n")

write_heatmap <- function(pcov_df, tcols, grp_lvls, colors, title, out_file, n_top = 30,
                          width = NULL, height = NULL) {
  hm_df <- pcov_df %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    select(all_of(c("row_id", tcols))) %>%
    column_to_rownames("row_id") %>% as.matrix()

  group_anno <- pcov_df %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    select(row_id, Group) %>% column_to_rownames("row_id") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls))

  tv <- apply(hm_df, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  valid <- names(tv)[!is.na(tv) & tv > 0]
  top_traits <- names(sort(tv[valid], decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(n_top, length(valid))]
  hm_mat <- t(hm_df[, top_traits, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(hm_mat) <- display_trait(rownames(hm_mat))

  cat_anno <- trait_cat_df %>% filter(trait %in% top_traits)
  hm_mat <- hm_mat[display_trait(cat_anno$trait), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(cat_anno) <- rownames(hm_mat)
  obs_cats <- short_category(as.character(cat_anno$category))
  cat_anno$category <- factor(obs_cats, levels = unique(obs_cats))
  cat_anno$trait <- NULL; cat_anno$super_category <- NULL

  n_groups <- length(grp_lvls)
  pheatmap(hm_mat, scale = "row", cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_colnames = FALSE, show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 9, fontsize_col = 10,
    annotation_col = group_anno, annotation_row = cat_anno,
    annotation_colors = list(Group = colors[grp_lvls],
                             category = CATEGORY_COLORS[as.character(levels(cat_anno$category))]),
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")))(100), border_color = NA,
    main = title,
    filename = out_file,
    width = if (is.null(width)) (if (n_groups >= 5) 9 else 7) else width,
    height = if (is.null(height)) 6.5 else height,
    dpi = 300)
}

write_heatmap(prop_cov, trait_cols, GROUP_LEVELS, GROUP_COLORS,
  "Top Variable Phenotypic Traits (All 6 Groups)",
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig1_phenotype_heatmap.png"))
write_heatmap(prop_cov, trait_cols, FOUR_LEVELS, FOUR_COLORS,
  "Top Variable Phenotypic Traits (Adenoma Follow-up)",
  file.path(FOUR_DIR, "fig1_phenotype_heatmap.png"),
  width = 9, height = 8)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Figure 2: Category boxplots (KW global test)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 2: Category boxplots...\n")

cat_prop <- wmean_long %>%
  group_by(row_id, Group, category) %>%
  summarise(cat_wmean = sum(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(category = factor(short_category(as.character(category)),
                           levels = unique(short_category(as.character(trait_cat_df$category)))))

cat_prop_4 <- cat_prop %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS) %>%
  mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = FOUR_LEVELS))

plot_cat_box <- function(df, grp_lvls, colors, title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = cat_wmean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8, aes(color = Group)) +
    facet_wrap(~category, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.signif", size = 5,
                       label.y.npc = "top", label.x.npc = "left") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Group", y = "Coverage-weighted category score") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 11),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}

p2 <- plot_cat_box(cat_prop, GROUP_LEVELS, GROUP_COLORS,
  "Functional Category Score by Group (Kruskal-Wallis)")
p2_4 <- plot_cat_box(cat_prop_4, FOUR_LEVELS, FOUR_COLORS,
  "Functional Category Score (Adenoma Follow-up)")
ggsave(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig2_category_boxplots.png"), p2, width = 13, height = 9.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(FOUR_DIR, "fig2_category_boxplots.png"), p2_4, width = 12, height = 8.5, dpi = 300)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Figure 3: Key traits boxplots (KW global test)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 3: Key traits boxplots...\n")

# Rank traits by global group effect (max - min group median) and pick the top
eff_scores <- wmean_long %>%
  group_by(trait, Group) %>% summarise(med = median(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(trait) %>% summarise(effect = max(med) - min(med), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(effect))
key_traits <- head(eff_scores$trait, 12)

plot_key_box <- function(df, grp_lvls, colors, title) {
  df_f <- df %>% filter(trait %in% key_traits) %>%
    mutate(trait = factor(display_trait(trait), levels = display_trait(key_traits)))
  ggplot(df_f, aes(x = Group, y = wmean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(position = position_jitter(width = 0.15), alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6, aes(color = Group)) +
    facet_wrap(~trait, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4,
               labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 20)) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test", label = "p.signif", size = 4.5,
                       label.y.npc = "top", label.x.npc = "left") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Group", y = "Coverage-weighted trait score") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5))
}

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Figure 4: Trait prevalence heatmap (% samples carrying trait)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 4: Trait prevalence heatmap...\n")

write_prevalence_hm <- function(pcount, tcols, grp_lvls, fname, width) {
  prev <- pcount %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    select(all_of(c("Group", tcols))) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(tcols), names_to = "trait", values_to = "count") %>%
    mutate(present = count > 0) %>%
    group_by(Group, trait) %>%
    summarise(n_total = n(), n_present = sum(present),
              prevalence = n_present / n_total * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls))

  pw <- prev %>% select(Group, trait, prevalence) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = prevalence, values_fn = mean) %>%
    column_to_rownames("trait")

  pw <- pw %>% rownames_to_column("trait") %>%
    left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>%
    mutate(category = short_category(as.character(category))) %>%
    arrange(category, desc(!!sym(grp_lvls[1]))) %>%
    select(-category, -super_category) %>%
    column_to_rownames("trait") %>% as.matrix()

  pheatmap(pw, cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
    show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = TRUE, fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 11,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B"))(100),
    border_color = NA, main = "Trait Prevalence (% samples carrying trait)",
    breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
    filename = fname, width = width, height = 13, dpi = 300)
}

  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig4_trait_prevalence_heatmap.png"), width = 6)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Figure 5: Aitchison PCoA + PERMANOVA (with betadisper test)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 5: Aitchison PCoA + PERMANOVA...\n")

make_pcoa <- function(pcov_df, grp_lvls, colors, title_str, out_file) {
  df <- pcov_df %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls))

  mat <- df %>% select(all_of(c("row_id", trait_cols))) %>%
    column_to_rownames("row_id") %>% as.matrix()

  # Remove zero-variance columns
  tv <- apply(mat, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE)
  mat <- mat[, tv > 0]

  # CLR transform (handles zeros with pseudocount) -> Aitchison distance
  clr_mat <- clr_transform(mat)
  dist_mat <- dist(clr_mat, method = "euclidean")

  # PCoA via cmdscale
  pcoa_res <- cmdscale(dist_mat, k = min(2, nrow(clr_mat) - 1), eig = TRUE)

  pos_eig <- pcoa_res$eig[pcoa_res$eig > 0]
  var_exp <- round(pos_eig[1:min(2, length(pos_eig))] / sum(pos_eig) * 100, 1)

  scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa_res$points)
  colnames(scores) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")[1:ncol(scores)]
  scores$row_id <- rownames(scores)

  rid_grp <- df %>% select(row_id, Group) %>% distinct()
  scores <- scores %>% left_join(rid_grp, by = "row_id")
  scores$Group <- factor(scores$Group, levels = grp_lvls)

  # PERMANOVA (adonis2)
  grp_vec <- scores$Group[match(labels(dist_mat), scores$row_id)]
  set.seed(42)
  adonis_res <- adonis2(dist_mat ~ grp_vec, permutations = 999)
  p_val <- adonis_res$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  r2 <- round(adonis_res$R2[1], 3)

  # Betadisper test (homogeneity of dispersion)
  beta_disp <- betadisper(dist_mat, grp_vec)
  beta_p <- anova(beta_disp)$`Pr(>F)`[1]

  cat(sprintf("  PERMANOVA: R2=%.3f, p=%.4f | Betadisper p=%.4f\n", r2, p_val, beta_p))

  centroids <- scores %>% group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(PCoA1 = mean(PCoA1), PCoA2 = mean(PCoA2), .groups = "drop")

  subtitle <- bquote("PERMANOVA: " ~ R^2 == .(r2) ~ ", p" == .(format.pval(p_val, digits = 3)) ~
    " | Dispersion p" == .(format.pval(beta_p, digits = 3)))

  p <- ggplot(scores, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Group, fill = Group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_point(data = centroids, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2), shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1.5, color = "black") +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls]) +
    labs(title = title_str, subtitle = subtitle,
         x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[1]),
         y = if (ncol(scores) >= 2) sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", var_exp[2]) else "PCoA2",
         fill = "Group", color = "Group") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15) +
    theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))

  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 7.5, height = 5.8, dpi = 300)
  list(scores = scores, adonis_r2 = r2, adonis_p = p_val, betadisper_p = beta_p)
}

  "Aitchison PCoA (All 6 Groups)", file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig5_pcoa_phenotype.png"))
res_4 <- make_pcoa(prop_cov %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS), FOUR_LEVELS, FOUR_COLORS,

# ==============================================================================
# 7. Figure 6: Differential analysis (KW + volcano)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 6: Differential phenotype analysis...\n")

make_kw_volcano <- function(long_df, title_str, out_file) {
  kw_res <- long_df %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(kw_stat = kruskal.test(wmean ~ Group)$statistic,
              kw_pval = kruskal.test(wmean ~ Group)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(kw_padj = p.adjust(kw_pval, method = "BH"),
           neg_log10_padj = -log10(kw_padj)) %>%
    left_join(trait_cat_df, by = "trait") %>% arrange(kw_padj)

  grp_med <- long_df %>% filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    group_by(trait, Group) %>% summarise(med = median(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  eff <- grp_med %>% group_by(trait) %>%
    summarise(effect_size = max(med) - min(med), .groups = "drop")

  kw_volc <- kw_res %>% left_join(eff, by = "trait") %>%
    mutate(super_category = factor(super_category, levels = names(SUPER_COLORS)))
  sig <- kw_volc %>% filter(kw_padj < 0.05) %>% slice_max(order_by = neg_log10_padj, n = 15)

  p <- ggplot(kw_volc, aes(x = effect_size, y = neg_log10_padj, color = super_category)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = SUPER_COLORS, name = "Super-category") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = sig, aes(label = wrap_label(display_trait(trait))),
      size = 3.5, max.overlaps = 25,
      box.padding = 0.4, segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0) +
    labs(title = title_str,
         x = "Effect Size (max - min group median)",
         y = expression(-log[10](adjusted ~ italic(p)))) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15)

  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 8, height = 5.8, dpi = 300)
  kw_res %>% select(trait, super_category, category, kw_stat, kw_pval, kw_padj)
}

kw_6 <- make_kw_volcano(wmean_long, "Differential Phenotypic Traits (All 6 Groups)",
  file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "fig6_differential_phenotype.png"))
kw_4 <- make_kw_volcano(wmean_long %>% filter(Group %in% FOUR_LEVELS),

plot_super_bar <- function(long_df, grp_lvls, title, out_file) {
  df <- long_df %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls)) %>%
    group_by(Group, super_category) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Group, y = mean_score, fill = super_category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", width = 0.75, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = SUPER_COLORS, name = "Super-category") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Group", y = "Relative Proportion") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
}

# 10. Figure 9: Category grouped bar (mean +/- SE)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 9: Category grouped bar...\n")

plot_cat_bar <- function(cprop, grp_lvls, colors, title, out_file) {
  df <- cprop %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    group_by(Group, category) %>%
    summarise(mean_wmean = mean(cat_wmean, na.rm = TRUE),
              se = sd(cat_wmean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp_lvls))
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = category, y = mean_wmean, fill = Group)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_wmean - se), ymax = mean_wmean + se),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls], name = "Group") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Mean coverage-weighted score +/- SE") +
    theme_nature(base_size = 14) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 12))
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}

# 11. Figure 10: All-trait dot plot (faceted by category)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\nCreating Figure 10: All-trait dot plot...\n")

plot_dotplot <- function(long_df, grp_lvls, colors, title, out_file) {
  df <- long_df %>% filter(Group %in% grp_lvls) %>%
    group_by(Group, category, trait) %>%
    summarise(mean_wmean = mean(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(category = factor(short_category(as.character(category)),
                             levels = unique(short_category(as.character(trait_cat_df$category)))),
           trait = reorder(display_trait(trait), mean_wmean, FUN = mean))
  global_max <- max(df$mean_wmean, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = mean_wmean, y = trait, color = Group)) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = global_max, y = trait, yend = trait),
                 color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2.2) +
    facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[grp_lvls], name = "Group") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Mean Coverage-Weighted Trait Score", y = NULL) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 14) +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 11, face = "bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"))
  ggsave(out_file, p, width = 11, height = 18, dpi = 300)
}

  group_by(Group, trait) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(wmean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = trait, values_from = mean) %>%
  arrange(Group)
save_csv(wide_matrix_4, file.path(FOUR_DIR, "table10_group_trait_mean_matrix_4adenoma.csv"))

# --- Table 11: Group x category mean matrix ---
cat("  Table 11: Group x category mean matrix...\n")
cat_wide <- cat_prop %>%

cat_wide_4 <- cat_prop %>%

save_csv(cat_wide_4, file.path(FOUR_DIR, "table11_group_category_mean_matrix_4adenoma.csv"))

# --- Table 12: Continuous trait descriptive statistics per group ---
cat("  Table 12: Continuous trait descriptive statistics...\n")
cont_stats <- cont_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%

  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),

    q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(ctrait, Group)
save_csv(cont_stats, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "table12_continuous_descriptive_statistics.csv"))

# --- Table 13: Kruskal-Wallis for continuous traits ---
cat("  Table 13: Continuous trait Kruskal-Wallis results...\n")
cont_kw <- cont_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  group_by(ctrait) %>%

save_csv(cont_kw, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "table13_continuous_kruskal_wallis.csv"))
save_csv(cont_kw_4, file.path(FOUR_DIR, "table13_continuous_kruskal_wallis_4adenoma.csv"))

cont_sample <- cont_sum %>%
```

## 3.5 Interpretation

1. **No microTrait trait is significant** after BH-FDR; predicted life-history
   traits are stable across recurrence status and sampling time.
2. Top raw-p traits are substrate-uptake and energy traits, but none survive
   correction.
3. Large effect sizes are coverage-driven and not supported by statistical
   tests.
# 4. dbCAN3

## 4.1 Overview

dbCAN3 annotates CAZyme families from MAGs (GH, GT, PL, CE, AA, CBM).
Per-sample proportions and coverage-weighted scores are compared across the 6
clinical groups and the 4-group adenoma subset (n = 236).

**Key results (4-group subset):** no family survives BH-FDR (all FDR = 0.955;
best raw p = 0.0040 for CBM27); PERMANOVA shows no separation (R2 = 0.0124,
P = 0.545).
## 4.2 Script

**Script:** targetc_dbcan3_plot_02.R

```r
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ============================================================================
# TargetC dbCAN3 CAZyme Visualization v2 (Publication Grade, Nature-sub style)
# ============================================================================
# Input:
#   Step 9 annotated CAZyme tables from 09-targetc_dbcan3_annotate_mimag90.py
#     cazy_summary_annotated_mimag90/

#       annotated_cazyme_proportion_len_cov.tsv
#       annotated_cazyme_score_coverage.tsv
#       annotated_cazyme_score_len_cov.tsv
#       annotated_cazyme_present_count.tsv
# Output:
#   dbcan3-plot-02/            all six clinical groups
#   dbcan3-plot-02/plot-4/     Recurrence_1/Recurrence_2/Non_recurrence_1/Non_recurrence_2
#   dbcan3-plot-02/pairwise/   pairwise comparisons, kept separate from main figures
#   Every table is written as both .tsv and .csv
# Style:
#   Large fonts, compact figure canvases (Nature-family journals).
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(cowplot)
  library(scales)
  library(vegan)

})

# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
ANNOTATED_DIR <- "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/phenotypes-analysis/dbcan3-analysis/results/cazy_summary_annotated_mimag90"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/phenotypes-analysis/dbcan3-analysis/results/dbcan3-plot-02"
FOUR_GROUP_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "plot-4")
PAIRWISE_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "pairwise")
PAIRWISE_FOUR_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PAIRWISE_OUTPUT_DIR, "plot-4")

PROP_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_proportion_coverage.tsv")
PROP_LEN_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_proportion_len_cov.tsv")

SCORE_LEN_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_score_len_cov.tsv")

# source -> clinical Group label
GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "N"    = "Normal",
  "Non1" = "Non_recurrence_1",
  "Non2" = "Non_recurrence_2",
  "Re1"  = "Recurrence_1",

)

GROUP_LEVELS <- unname(GROUP_LABELS)
FOUR_GROUP_LEVELS <- c(
  "Recurrence_1",
  "Recurrence_2",
  "Non_recurrence_1",
  "Non_recurrence_2"
)

GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "Normal"           = "#2166AC",
  "Recurrence_1"     = "#B2182B",
  "Recurrence_2"     = "#D6604D",

  "Non_recurrence_2" = "#35978F",
  "CRC"              = "#762A83"
)

CLASS_COLORS <- c(
  GH  = "#B2182B",
  GT  = "#2166AC",
  PL  = "#1B7837",
  CE  = "#E08214",
  AA  = "#762A83",
  CBM = "#35978F",
  Other = "grey60"
)

# ============================================================================
# Helpers
# ============================================================================
get_family_cols <- function(dat) {
  setdiff(
    colnames(dat),
    c("SID", "profile_column", "source", "sample_id", "Group")
  )
}

cazyme_class <- function(x) {
  cls <- sub("^([A-Z]+).*$", "\\1", as.character(x))
  cls[!cls %in% names(CLASS_COLORS)] <- "Other"
  factor(cls, levels = names(CLASS_COLORS))
}

read_annotated <- function(path) {
  dat <- read.delim(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("NA", "")
  )
  required <- c("SID", "profile_column", "source")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required, colnames(dat))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in ", path, ": ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  input_rows <- nrow(dat)
  dat$sample_id <- dat$profile_column
  dat$Group <- unname(GROUP_LABELS[as.character(dat$source)])
  dat$Group <- factor(dat$Group, levels = unname(GROUP_LABELS))
  excluded_rows <- sum(is.na(dat$Group))
  out <- dat[!is.na(dat$Group), , drop = FALSE]
  attr(out, "input_rows") <- input_rows
  attr(out, "excluded_rows") <- excluded_rows
  out
}

subset_group <- function(dat, group_levels) {
  dat %>%
    filter(Group %in% group_levels) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))
}

make_long <- function(dat, value_name) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(dat)
  dat %>%
    select(sample_id, source, Group, all_of(fams)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(fams),
      names_to = "family",
      values_to = value_name
    ) %>%
    mutate(class = cazyme_class(family))
}

make_class_by_sample <- function(prop_long) {
  prop_long %>%
    group_by(sample_id, source, Group, class) %>%
    summarise(
      class_proportion = sum(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

write_results <- function(x, file) {
  dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write.table(
    x,
    file = file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    na = "NA"
  )
  csv_file <- sub("[.]tsv$", ".csv", file)
  write.table(
    x,
    file = csv_file,
    sep = ",",

    row.names = FALSE,

}

save_figure <- function(p, prefix, dir, width = 5.5, height = 4.5) {
  ggsave(
    file.path(dir, paste0(prefix, ".png")),
    p,
    width = width,
    height = height,

  )

    file.path(dir, paste0(prefix, ".pdf")),

}

format_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      sprintf("%.3f", p)
    )
  )
}

# Publication theme: large fonts on a compact canvas (Nature-sub style)
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 17) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 3, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 2, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", color = "grey30"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# ============================================================================
# CLR / Aitchison PCoA
# ============================================================================
clr_transform <- function(mat) {
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  pos <- mat[mat > 0]
  delta <- if (length(pos) > 0) min(pos) / 2 else 0.5
  mat[mat == 0] <- delta
  t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) log(x) - mean(log(x))))
}

run_beta <- function(prop_wide, group_levels) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(prop_wide)
  dat <- prop_wide %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))

  mat <- as.matrix(dat[, fams, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- dat$sample_id
  clr <- clr_transform(mat)
  d <- dist(clr, method = "euclidean")

  set.seed(42)
  ad <- adonis2(d ~ Group, data = dat, permutations = 999)
  disp <- anova(betadisper(d, dat$Group))

  pcoa <- cmdscale(d, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  eig <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]
  var_explained <- if (length(eig) >= 2) {
    round(eig[1:2] / sum(eig) * 100, 1)
  } else {
    c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
  }

  scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)
  colnames(scores) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
  scores$sample_id <- rownames(scores)
  scores <- scores %>%
    left_join(dat %>% select(sample_id, Group), by = "sample_id")

  list(
    scores = scores,
    var_explained = var_explained,
    r2 = ad$R2[1],
    p = ad$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    disp_p = disp$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}

plot_pcoa <- function(beta, group_levels, title) {
  scores <- beta$scores
  centroids <- scores %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
      PCoA1 = mean(PCoA1, na.rm = TRUE),
      PCoA2 = mean(PCoA2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  subtitle <- sprintf(
    "PERMANOVA R2 = %.3f, P = %s | dispersion P = %s",
    beta$r2,
    format_p(beta$p),
    format_p(beta$disp_p)
  )

  ggplot(scores, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Group, fill = Group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 2.2) +
    geom_point(
      data = centroids,
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.5,
      stroke = 1.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.25) +
    scale_color_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", beta$var_explained[1]),
      y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", beta$var_explained[2]),
      color = "Group",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15)
}
```
