```r
plot_gh_pl <- function(prop_long, group_levels, title) {
  sub <- prop_long %>%
    filter(class %in% c("GH", "PL"), !is.na(Group))

  stats <- sub %>%
    group_by(class) %>%
    summarise(
      p = suppressWarnings(
        tryCatch(
          kruskal.test(proportion, Group)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot(sub, aes(x = Group, y = proportion, fill = Group)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.35, scale = "width", width = 0.85) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.14, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.35, color = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~class, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    geom_text(
      data = stats,
      aes(
        x = 1.5,
        y = Inf,
        label = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis P = ", format_p(p))
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 4.5
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "GH and PL family proportions by clinical group",
      x = "Group",
      y = "CAZyme family proportion",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.18)))
}

# ============================================================================
# Differential analysis
# ============================================================================
differential_analysis <- function(prop_long, count_wide, group_levels) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(count_wide)
  dat <- count_wide %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))

  present_fams <- fams[
    colSums(dat[, fams, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  ]

  use_aldex <- requireNamespace("ALDEx2", quietly = TRUE)
  method <- "Kruskal-Wallis + BH (ALDEx2 not installed)"
  res <- NULL

  if (use_aldex && length(present_fams) > 1) {
    count_mat <- as.matrix(dat[, present_fams, drop = FALSE])
    rownames(count_mat) <- dat$sample_id
    set.seed(42)
    al <- tryCatch(
      ALDEx2::aldex(
        count_mat,
        dat$Group,
        mc.samples = 128,
        test = "kw",
        effect = TRUE,
        denom = "all"
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (!inherits(al, "error")) {
      res <- data.frame(
        family = rownames(al),
        p.value = al$kw.ep,
        FDR = al$kw.eBH,
        aldex_effect = al$effect,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      method <- "ALDEx2 Kruskal-Wallis (Monte Carlo CLR; 128 Dirichlet samples)"
      use_aldex <- TRUE
    } else {
      use_aldex <- FALSE
      warning("ALDEx2 failed; falling back to Kruskal-Wallis: ", conditionMessage(al))
    }
  } else {
    use_aldex <- FALSE
  }

  if (!use_aldex) {
    res <- prop_long %>%
      group_by(family) %>%
      summarise(
        p.value = suppressWarnings(
          tryCatch(
            kruskal.test(proportion, Group)$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          )
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    res$FDR <- NA_real_
    idx <- !is.na(res$p.value)
    res$FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(res$p.value[idx], method = "BH")
    res$aldex_effect <- NA_real_
  }

  stats <- prop_long %>%
    group_by(family, Group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_prop = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_prop = median(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_prop = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  median_wide <- stats %>%
    select(family, Group, median_prop) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = median_prop)
  mean_wide <- stats %>%
    select(family, Group, mean_prop) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = mean_prop)

  med_cols <- setdiff(colnames(median_wide), "family")
  mean_cols <- setdiff(colnames(mean_wide), "family")
  median_mat <- as.matrix(median_wide[, med_cols, drop = FALSE])
  mean_mat <- as.matrix(mean_wide[, mean_cols, drop = FALSE])

  effect_size <- apply(
    median_mat,
    1,
    function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  log2fc <- log2(
    (apply(median_mat, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-6) /
      (apply(median_mat, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-6)
  )
  mean_range <- apply(
    mean_mat,
    1,
    function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  effect_df <- data.frame(
    family = median_wide$family,
    effect_size = effect_size,
    log2FC = log2fc,
    mean_range = mean_range,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  res <- res %>%
    left_join(effect_df, by = "family") %>%
    left_join(median_wide, by = "family") %>%
    left_join(mean_wide, by = "family") %>%
    mutate(class = cazyme_class(family)) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(effect_size)))

  attr(res, "method") <- method
  res
}

plot_volcano <- function(
  diff_res,
  group_levels,
  title,
  subtitle = "FDR from ALDEx2 or Kruskal-Wallis; effect size = range of group median proportions",
  x_label = "Effect size (max-min group median proportion)"
) {
  dat <- diff_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(FDR), !is.na(effect_size))
  dat$FDR <- pmax(dat$FDR, 1e-300)
  sig <- dat %>%
    filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(effect_size))) %>%
    head(15)

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = effect_size, y = -log10(FDR), color = class)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = CLASS_COLORS) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      color = "CAZyme class"
    ) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 10, b = 20, l = 8))

  if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = sig,
        aes(label = family),
        size = 3.6,
        max.overlaps = 30,
        box.padding = 0.4,
        segment.color = "grey50",
        segment.size = 0.3,
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
  }
  p
}

plot_top_family_boxplots <- function(prop_long, diff_res, group_levels) {
  sig <- diff_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(FDR)) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(effect_size))) %>%
    head(12)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) {
    sig <- diff_res %>% arrange(desc(abs(effect_size))) %>% head(12)
  }

  sub <- prop_long %>%
    filter(family %in% sig$family) %>%
    mutate(family = factor(family, levels = sig$family))

  ggplot(sub, aes(x = Group, y = proportion, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.65, width = 0.55) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.35, color = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~family, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    labs(
      title = "Top Differential CAZyme Families",
      x = "Group",
      y = "Proportion (coverage-weighted)",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 8, b = 8, l = 12)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3)
}

save_diff_heatmap <- function(
  prop_cov,
  diff_res,
  group_levels,
  filename,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 6.5
) {
  sig <- diff_res %>% filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.05)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) {
    sig <- diff_res %>%
      filter(!is.na(FDR)) %>%
      arrange(FDR) %>%
      head(40)
  }
  sig <- sig %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(effect_size))) %>%
    head(40)

  fams <- sig$family
  if (length(fams) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  dat <- prop_cov %>% filter(!is.na(Group))
  mat <- as.matrix(dat[, fams, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- dat$sample_id
  mat_t <- t(mat)
  mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat_t)))
  keep <- apply(
    mat_z,
    1,
    function(x) !any(!is.finite(x)) && sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  )
  mat_z <- mat_z[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(mat_z) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  ann_row <- data.frame(
    Class = cazyme_class(rownames(mat_z)),
    row.names = rownames(mat_z)
  )
  ann_col <- data.frame(
    Group = dat$Group,
    row.names = dat$sample_id
  )

  pheatmap(
    mat_z,
    scale = "none",
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    annotation_row = ann_row,
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_colors = list(
      Group = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels],
      Class = CLASS_COLORS
    ),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
    border_color = NA,
    show_colnames = FALSE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 11,
    fontsize_col = 12,
    main = "Z-score Heatmap of Differential CAZyme Families",
    filename = filename,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

prevalence_summary <- function(count_long, group_levels) {
  count_long %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    group_by(Group, family) %>%
    summarise(
      n_present = sum(count > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples = n(),
      prevalence = 100 * sum(count > 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(class = cazyme_class(family))
}

plot_richness_abundance <- function(prop_cov, count_wide, group_levels) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(prop_cov)
  rich_df <- data.frame(
    sample_id = count_wide$sample_id,
    Group = factor(count_wide$Group, levels = group_levels),
    richness = rowSums(count_wide[, fams, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  abund_df <- data.frame(
    sample_id = prop_cov$sample_id,
    total_prop = rowSums(prop_cov[, fams, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  dat <- merge(rich_df, abund_df, by = "sample_id")

  p1 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Group, y = richness, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.65, width = 0.55) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.35, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    labs(
      title = "CAZyme Family Richness",
      x = "Group",
      y = "Number of present families",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 17) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  p2 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = Group, y = total_prop, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.65, width = 0.55) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.35, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    labs(
      title = "Total CAZyme Abundance",
      x = "Group",
      y = "Sum of coverage-weighted proportions",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 17) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  plot_grid(
    p1,
    p2,
    ncol = 2,
    labels = c("A", "B"),
    align = "h",
    axis = "tb"
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# Pairwise comparison results (written only under dbcan3-plot-02/pairwise/)
# ============================================================================
pairwise_groups <- function(prop_long, group_levels) {
  group_levels <- group_levels[group_levels %in% prop_long$Group]
  if (length(group_levels) < 2) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  combs <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  out <- lapply(combs, function(grp) {
    g1 <- grp[1]
    g2 <- grp[2]
    dat <- prop_long %>%
      filter(Group %in% grp) %>%
      mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp))

    res <- dat %>%
      group_by(family) %>%
      summarise(
        n1 = sum(Group == g1),
        n2 = sum(Group == g2),
        median1 = median(proportion[Group == g1], na.rm = TRUE),
        median2 = median(proportion[Group == g2], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean1 = mean(proportion[Group == g1], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean2 = mean(proportion[Group == g2], na.rm = TRUE),
        p.value = suppressWarnings(
          tryCatch(
            wilcox.test(
              proportion[Group == g1],
              proportion[Group == g2]
            )$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          )
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    res$FDR <- NA_real_
    idx <- !is.na(res$p.value)
    res$FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(res$p.value[idx], method = "BH")
    res$log2FC <- log2(
      (res$median1 + 1e-6) / (res$median2 + 1e-6)
    )
    res$effect_size <- res$median1 - res$median2
    res$group1 <- g1
    res$group2 <- g2
    res$comparison <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)
    res$class <- cazyme_class(res$family)
    res
  })

  bind_rows(out)
}

write_pairwise_matrices <- function(pairwise, tables_dir, prefix = "cazyme") {
  if (nrow(pairwise) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  comparisons <- unique(pairwise$comparison)
  families <- unique(pairwise$family)

  matrix_from_pairwise <- function(value_col) {
    mat <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = length(families),
      ncol = length(comparisons),
      dimnames = list(families, comparisons)
    )
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairwise))) {
      mat[pairwise$family[i], pairwise$comparison[i]] <-
        pairwise[[value_col]][i]
    }
    mat
  }

  write_results(
    cbind(
      family = rownames(matrix_from_pairwise("log2FC")),
      as.data.frame(matrix_from_pairwise("log2FC"), check.names = FALSE)
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(prefix, "_pairwise_log2FC_matrix.tsv"))
  )
  write_results(
    cbind(
      family = rownames(matrix_from_pairwise("FDR")),
      as.data.frame(matrix_from_pairwise("FDR"), check.names = FALSE)
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(prefix, "_pairwise_FDR_matrix.tsv"))
  )
  write_results(
    cbind(
      family = rownames(matrix_from_pairwise("effect_size")),
      as.data.frame(matrix_from_pairwise("effect_size"), check.names = FALSE)
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(prefix, "_pairwise_effect_size_matrix.tsv"))
  )
}

save_pairwise_heatmap <- function(
  pairwise,
  filename,
  width = 6,
  height = 9
) {
  if (nrow(pairwise) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  sig_fams <- pairwise %>%
    filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.05) %>%
    pull(family) %>%
    unique()
  if (length(sig_fams) == 0) {
    sig_fams <- pairwise %>%
      group_by(family) %>%
      summarise(min_fdr = min(FDR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(min_fdr) %>%
      head(40) %>%
      pull(family)
  }
  if (length(sig_fams) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  mat <- pairwise %>%
    filter(family %in% sig_fams) %>%
    select(family, comparison, log2FC) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = comparison, values_from = log2FC) %>%
    column_to_rownames("family") %>%
    as.matrix()
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

  finite_vals <- mat[is.finite(mat)]
  if (any(is.infinite(mat))) {
    max_abs <- max(abs(finite_vals), na.rm = TRUE)
    mat[is.infinite(mat)] <- sign(mat[is.infinite(mat)]) * max_abs
  }
  if (max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  lim <- max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE)

  ann_row <- data.frame(
    Class = cazyme_class(rownames(mat)),
    row.names = rownames(mat)
  )

  pheatmap(
    mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    annotation_row = ann_row,
    annotation_colors = list(Class = CLASS_COLORS),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
    breaks = seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101),
    border_color = "grey85",
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 11,
    fontsize_col = 12,
    main = "Pairwise Log2FC (FDR-significant families)",
    filename = filename,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

run_pairwise_outputs <- function(
  prop_cov,
  group_levels,
  output_dir,
  title_tag
) {
  dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tables_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")

  cat("\nPairwise processing:", title_tag, "->", output_dir, "\n")

  prop_long <- make_long(prop_cov, "proportion")
  pairwise <- pairwise_groups(prop_long, group_levels)

  if (nrow(pairwise) == 0) {
    cat("  No pairwise comparisons produced.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  write_results(
    pairwise,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_pairwise_results.tsv")
  )
  write_pairwise_matrices(pairwise, tables_dir)

  comparison_summary <- pairwise %>%
    group_by(comparison, group1, group2, n1, n2) %>%
    summarise(
      n_families = n(),
      n_significant_FDR_0.05 = sum(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_upregulated_in_group1 = sum(log2FC > 0 & FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_downregulated_in_group1 = sum(log2FC < 0 & FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(comparison)
  write_results(
    comparison_summary,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_pairwise_comparison_summary.tsv")
  )

  save_pairwise_heatmap(
    pairwise,
    file.path(output_dir, "figS2_pairwise_differential_heatmap.png"),
    width = 6,
    height = 9
  )

  comparisons <- unique(pairwise$comparison)
  for (cc in comparisons) {
    cc_dat <- pairwise %>% filter(comparison == cc)
    prefix <- paste0(
      "figS1_pairwise_volcano_",
      gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", cc)
    )
    save_figure(
      plot_volcano(
        cc_dat,
        group_levels,
        paste(title_tag, "CAZyme Pairwise Volcano:", cc),
        subtitle = "Wilcoxon rank-sum test with BH FDR; effect size = median1 - median2",
        x_label = "Effect size (median group1 - median group2)"
      ),
      prefix,
      output_dir,
      width = 5.5,
      height = 5
    )
  }

  cat("  Finished pairwise:", title_tag, "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# Summary tables
# ============================================================================
make_metric_summary <- function(metric_wides, group_levels) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(metric_wides[[1]])
  out <- lapply(names(metric_wides), function(nm) {
    metric_wides[[nm]] %>%
      filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
      select(sample_id, Group, all_of(fams)) %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(fams), names_to = "family", values_to = "value") %>%
      group_by(Group, family) %>%
      summarise(
        mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_samples = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        metric = nm,
        class = cazyme_class(family),
        Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels)
      )
  })
  bind_rows(out)
}

# ============================================================================
# Run one output set
# ============================================================================
run_outputs <- function(
  prop_cov,
  prop_len_cov,
  score_cov,
  score_len_cov,
  count_wide,
  group_levels,
  output_dir,
  title_tag
) {
  dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tables_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")

  cat("\nProcessing:", title_tag, "->", output_dir, "\n")

  prop_long <- make_long(prop_cov, "proportion")
  count_long <- make_long(count_wide, "count")

  sample_summary <- prop_cov %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(n_samples = n(), .groups = "drop")
  write_results(
    sample_summary,
    file.path(tables_dir, "group_sample_summary.tsv")
  )

  class_by_sample <- make_class_by_sample(prop_long)
  class_summary <- class_by_sample %>%
    group_by(Group, class) %>%
    summarise(
      mean = mean(class_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(class_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(class_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sd(class_proportion, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      n_samples = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  write_results(
    class_summary,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_class_summary.tsv")
  )

  family_summary <- prop_long %>%
    group_by(Group, class, family) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_prop = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_prop = median(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_prop = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  write_results(
    family_summary,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_family_summary.tsv")
  )

  metric_wides <- list(
    proportion_coverage = prop_cov,
    proportion_len_cov = prop_len_cov,
    score_coverage = score_cov,
    score_len_cov = score_len_cov,
    present_count = count_wide
  )
  metric_summary <- make_metric_summary(metric_wides, group_levels)
  write_results(
    metric_summary,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_metric_family_summary.tsv")
  )

  write_results(
    prop_long,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_proportion_long.tsv")
  )
  write_results(
    count_long,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_present_count_long.tsv")
  )

  beta <- run_beta(prop_cov, group_levels)
  write_results(
    data.frame(
      analysis = title_tag,
      method = "Aitchison PCoA (CLR + Euclidean distance)",
      PERMANOVA_R2 = beta$r2,
      PERMANOVA_P = beta$p,
      Dispersion_P = beta$disp_p,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_permanova_stats.tsv")
  )
  write_results(
    beta$scores,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_aitchison_pcoa_scores.tsv")
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_pcoa(beta, group_levels, paste(title_tag, "Aitchison PCoA")),
    "fig1_aitchison_pcoa",
    output_dir,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )

  diff_res <- differential_analysis(prop_long, count_wide, group_levels)
  cat("  Differential method:", attr(diff_res, "method"), "\n")
  write_results(
    diff_res,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_differential_results.tsv")
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_volcano(
      diff_res,
      group_levels,
      paste(title_tag, "CAZyme Differential Volcano")
    ),
    "fig4_differential_volcano",
    output_dir,
    width = 7,
    height = 6
  )
  save_diff_heatmap(
    prop_cov,
    diff_res,
    group_levels,
    file.path(output_dir, "fig5_diff_cazyme_heatmap.png"),
    width = 6.5,
    height = 6.5
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_top_family_boxplots(prop_long, diff_res, group_levels),
    "fig7_top_family_boxplots",
    output_dir,
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )

  save_figure(
    plot_class_stack(
      class_by_sample,
      group_levels,
      paste(title_tag, "CAZyme Class Composition")
    ),
    "fig2_class_stacked_bar",
    output_dir,
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_gh_pl(
      prop_long,
      group_levels,
      paste(title_tag, "GH and PL Family Proportions")
    ),
    "fig3_gh_pl_violin",
    output_dir,
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )

  prev <- prevalence_summary(count_long, group_levels)
  write_results(
    prev,
    file.path(tables_dir, "cazyme_prevalence_summary.tsv")
  )
  plot_prevalence_heatmap(
    prev,
    group_levels,
    file.path(output_dir, "fig6_prevalence_heatmap.png"),
    width = 6,
    height = 14
  )

  save_figure(
    plot_richness_abundance(prop_cov, count_wide, group_levels),
    "fig8_richness_abundance",
    output_dir,
    width = 7,
    height = 3.8
  )

  save_figure(
    plot_family_dotplot(
      prop_long,
      group_levels,
      paste(title_tag, "CAZyme Family Dot Plot")
    ),
    "fig10_cazyme_family_dotplot",
    output_dir,
    width = 8,
    height = 20
  )

  cat("  Finished:", title_tag, "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# Main
# ============================================================================
cat("Reading Step 9 annotated CAZyme tables...\n")
prop_cov_all <- read_annotated(PROP_COV_FILE)
prop_len_cov_all <- read_annotated(PROP_LEN_COV_FILE)
score_cov_all <- read_annotated(SCORE_COV_FILE)

)
input_summary$file <- rownames(input_summary)
input_summary <- input_summary[, c(

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
```

## 4.3 Results

**Sample sizes (4-group adenoma subset):** Recurrence_1 = 59, Recurrence_2 =
59, Non_recurrence_1 = 59, Non_recurrence_2 = 59 (n = 236).

**Differential analysis, 4-group (top raw-p families):**

| Family | Class | p | FDR | log2FC | Effect size |
|--------|-------|---|-----|--------|-------------|
| CBM27 | CBM | 0.0040 | 0.955 | 9.06 | 0.00053 |
| GH125 | GH | 0.0062 | 0.955 | 1.11 | 0.00136 |
| GH26 | GH | 0.0104 | 0.955 | 0.98 | 0.00159 |
| GH6 | GH | 0.0152 | 0.955 | 0.87 | 0.00299 |
| CBM23 | CBM | 0.0095 | 0.955 | 9.65 | 0.00080 |

**PERMANOVA + betadisper (4-group):**

| Method | R² | PERMANOVA p | Dispersion p |
|--------|----|-------------|--------------|
| Aitchison PCoA (CLR + Euclidean) | 0.0124 | 0.545 | 0.224 |

## 4.5 Interpretation

1. **No CAZyme family is significant** after FDR; the carbohydrate-active
   repertoire is stable across recurrence status and sampling time.
2. Top raw-p hits are CBM and GH families involved in hemicellulose, xylan and
   cellulose degradation, but none survive correction.
3. Including Normal and CRC gives the same null multivariate result
   (R2 = 0.0127, P = 0.597).
# 5. dbCAN3 mucin modules

## 5.1 Overview

To reduce multiple testing, curated CAZyme families are collapsed into four
mucin / glycan modules:

| Module | CAZyme families | Biological role |
|--------|-----------------|-----------------|
| mucin_core | GH29, GH95, GH33, GH109, GH16, GH136 | Core mucin O-glycan degradation (fucose, sialic acid, GalNAc) |
| mucin_ext | GH2, GH20, GH35, GH42, GH84, GH85, GH89, GH97, GH98, GH101, GH123, GH129, GH151 | Extended mucin glycan degradation |
| chitin | GH18, GH19, GH20, GH23, CBM2, CBM5 | Chitin utilization |
| plant | GH5, GH26, GH28, GH43, GH51, GH53, GH67, GH78, GH105, GH115, CE1, CE4, CE12, PL1, PL3, PL4, PL9 | Plant polysaccharide degradation |

**Key results (4-group subset):** no module is significant (plant p = 0.178,
chitin p = 0.396, mucin_ext p = 0.671, mucin_core p = 0.676); PERMANOVA
R2 = 0.0124, P = 0.503; strongest family hit is GH26 (p = 0.0104,
FDR = 0.418).
## 5.2 Script

**Script:** targetc_dbcan3_mucin_modules.R

```r
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ============================================================================
# TargetC dbCAN3 Targeted Mechanism-Module Analysis (Mucin / Chitin / Plant)
# ============================================================================
# Rationale:
#   Aggregating CAZymes into broad classes (GH/GT/PL) hides function-specific
#   signal behind metabolic redundancy. This script instead targets curated
#   functional modules:
#     - mucin_core : core mucin O-glycan degradation families
#                   (GH29, GH95, GH33, GH109, GH16, GH136)
#     - mucin_ext  : extended mucin O-glycan degradation families
#     - chitin     : chitin utilization
#     - plant      : plant polysaccharide degradation
#   For each module a per-sample "module degradation potential" is computed
#   (sum of coverage-weighted family proportions), tested across clinical
#   groups, and the targeted families themselves are taken through
#   differential / pairwise / prevalence / ordination analyses.
# Input:
#   Step 9 annotated CAZyme tables (same as targetc_dbcan3_plot.R)
# Output:
#   dbcan3-plot-mucin/            all six clinical groups  (mucin_-prefixed files)
#   dbcan3-plot-mucin/dbcan3-4/   Recurrence_1/Recurrence_2/Non_recurrence_1/Non_recurrence_2
#   dbcan3-plot-mucin/pairwise/   pairwise comparisons
#   Every table is written as both .tsv and .csv
# ============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(scales)
  library(vegan)
  library(ggrepel)
})

# ============================================================================
# Paths and group definitions
# ============================================================================
ANNOTATED_DIR <- "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/phenotypes-analysis/dbcan3-analysis/results/cazy_summary_annotated_mimag90"
OUTPUT_DIR <- "/home/yanglun/YSD/TargetC/phenotypes-analysis/dbcan3-analysis/results/dbcan3-plot-mucin"
FOUR_GROUP_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "dbcan3-4")
PAIRWISE_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "pairwise")
PAIRWISE_FOUR_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PAIRWISE_OUTPUT_DIR, "dbcan3-4")

PROP_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_proportion_coverage.tsv")
PROP_LEN_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_proportion_len_cov.tsv")
SCORE_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_score_coverage.tsv")
SCORE_LEN_COV_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_score_len_cov.tsv")
COUNT_FILE <- file.path(ANNOTATED_DIR, "annotated_cazyme_present_count.tsv")

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "N"    = "Normal",
  "Non1" = "Non_recurrence_1",
  "Non2" = "Non_recurrence_2",
  "Re1"  = "Recurrence_1",
  "Re2"  = "Recurrence_2",
  "CRC"  = "CRC"
)

GROUP_LEVELS <- unname(GROUP_LABELS)
FOUR_GROUP_LEVELS <- c(
  "Recurrence_1",
  "Recurrence_2",
  "Non_recurrence_1",
  "Non_recurrence_2"
)

GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "Normal"           = "#2166AC",
  "Recurrence_1"     = "#B2182B",
  "Recurrence_2"     = "#D6604D",
  "Non_recurrence_1" = "#1B7837",
  "Non_recurrence_2" = "#35978F",
  "CRC"              = "#762A83"
)

# ============================================================================
# Targeted functional modules
# ============================================================================
MODULES <- list(
  mucin_core = c("GH29", "GH95", "GH33", "GH109", "GH16", "GH136"),
  mucin_ext  = c(
    "GH2",  "GH20", "GH35", "GH42", "GH84", "GH85",
    "GH89", "GH97", "GH98", "GH101", "GH123", "GH129", "GH151"
  ),
  chitin = c("GH18", "GH19", "GH20", "GH23", "CBM2", "CBM5"),
  plant  = c(
    "GH5", "GH26", "GH28", "GH43", "GH51", "GH53", "GH67",
    "GH78", "GH105", "GH115", "CE1", "CE4", "CE12", "PL1", "PL3", "PL4", "PL9"
  )
)

MODULE_LABELS <- c(
  mucin_core = "Mucin degradation (core)",
  mucin_ext  = "Mucin degradation (extended)",
  chitin     = "Chitin utilization",
  plant      = "Plant polysaccharide degradation"
)

MODULE_COLORS <- c(
  mucin_core = "#B2182B",
  mucin_ext  = "#D6604D",
  chitin     = "#2166AC",
  plant      = "#1B7837"
)

# family -> modules lookup (a family may belong to >1 module)
fam_to_modules <- list()
for (.m in names(MODULES)) {
  for (.f in MODULES[[.m]]) {
    fam_to_modules[[.f]] <- c(fam_to_modules[[.f]], .m)
  }
}

module_annotation <- function(fams) {
  vapply(as.character(fams), function(f) {
    ms <- fam_to_modules[[f]]
    if (is.null(ms)) return("unassigned")
    paste(sort(unique(ms)), collapse = "+")
  }, character(1))
}

primary_module <- function(fams) {
  vapply(as.character(fams), function(f) {
    ms <- fam_to_modules[[f]]
    if (is.null(ms)) return("unassigned")
    idx <- match(ms, names(MODULES))
    names(MODULES)[min(idx)]
  }, character(1))
}

# ============================================================================
# Helpers
# ============================================================================
get_family_cols <- function(dat) {
  setdiff(
    colnames(dat),
    c("SID", "profile_column", "source", "sample_id", "Group")
  )
}

cazyme_class <- function(x) {
  cls <- sub("^([A-Z]+).*$", "\\1", as.character(x))
  factor(cls)
}

read_annotated <- function(path) {
  dat <- read.delim(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("NA", "")
  )
  required <- c("SID", "profile_column", "source")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required, colnames(dat))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in ", path, ": ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  input_rows <- nrow(dat)
  dat$sample_id <- dat$profile_column
  dat$Group <- unname(GROUP_LABELS[as.character(dat$source)])
  dat$Group <- factor(dat$Group, levels = unname(GROUP_LABELS))
  excluded_rows <- sum(is.na(dat$Group))
  out <- dat[!is.na(dat$Group), , drop = FALSE]
  attr(out, "input_rows") <- input_rows
  attr(out, "excluded_rows") <- excluded_rows
  out
}

subset_group <- function(dat, group_levels) {
  dat %>%
    filter(Group %in% group_levels) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))
}

make_long <- function(dat, value_name) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(dat)
  dat %>%
    select(sample_id, source, Group, all_of(fams)) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(fams),
      names_to = "family",
      values_to = value_name
    )
}

write_results <- function(x, file) {
  dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write.table(
    x,
    file = file,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    na = "NA"
  )
  csv_file <- sub("[.]tsv$", ".csv", file)
  write.table(
    x,
    file = csv_file,
    sep = ",",
    quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    na = "NA"
  )
}

save_figure <- function(p, prefix, dir, width = 5.5, height = 4.5) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible(NULL))
  ggsave(
    file.path(dir, paste0(prefix, ".png")),
    p,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 300
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(dir, paste0(prefix, ".pdf")),
    p,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in"
  )
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p),
    "NA",
    ifelse(
      p < 0.001,
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
      sprintf("%.3f", p)
    )
  )
}

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 17) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 3, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size - 2, hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", color = "grey30"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# ============================================================================
# Module aggregate (degradation potential per sample per module)
# ============================================================================
target_families <- function(dat) {
  intersect(unique(unlist(MODULES)), get_family_cols(dat))
}

module_aggregate <- function(prop_cov, count_wide) {
  tfams <- target_families(prop_cov)
  if (length(tfams) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  prop_mat <- as.matrix(prop_cov[, tfams, drop = FALSE])
  count_mat <- as.matrix(count_wide[, intersect(tfams, colnames(count_wide)), drop = FALSE])
  out <- lapply(names(MODULES), function(m) {
    fams <- intersect(MODULES[[m]], tfams)
    if (length(fams) == 0) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      sample_id = prop_cov$sample_id,
      Group = prop_cov$Group,
      module_key = m,
      module = MODULE_LABELS[[m]],
      n_families = length(fams),
      module_proportion = rowSums(prop_mat[, fams, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
      module_count = rowSums(count_mat[, fams, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE),
      module_richness = rowSums(count_mat[, fams, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  bind_rows(out)
}

module_group_summary <- function(mod_agg) {
  mod_agg %>%
    group_by(module_key, module, Group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_samples = n(),
      mean_proportion = mean(module_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_proportion = median(module_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_proportion = sd(module_proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_richness = mean(module_richness, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_richness = median(module_richness, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_richness = sd(module_richness, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

module_kw_stats <- function(mod_agg) {
  mod_agg %>%
    group_by(module_key, module) %>%
    summarise(
      kruskal_p_proportion = suppressWarnings(
        tryCatch(
          kruskal.test(module_proportion, Group)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      ),
      kruskal_p_richness = suppressWarnings(
        tryCatch(
          kruskal.test(module_richness, Group)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

plot_module_boxplots <- function(mod_agg, group_levels, title) {
  stats <- mod_agg %>%
    group_by(module_key, module) %>%
    summarise(
      p = suppressWarnings(
        tryCatch(
          kruskal.test(module_proportion, Group)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot(mod_agg, aes(x = Group, y = module_proportion, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.65, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.55, alpha = 0.3, color = "grey25") +
    facet_wrap(~module, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    geom_text(
      data = stats,
      aes(
        x = 1.5,
        y = Inf,
        label = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis P = ", format_p(p))
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.5,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Module degradation potential (sum of coverage-weighted family proportions)",
      x = "Group",
      y = "Module proportion",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 17) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

module_pairwise <- function(mod_agg) {
  group_levels <- levels(mod_agg$Group)
  group_levels <- group_levels[group_levels %in% mod_agg$Group]
  if (length(group_levels) < 2) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  combs <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  out <- lapply(unique(mod_agg$module_key), function(mk) {
    d <- mod_agg %>% filter(module_key == mk)
    mod_label <- unique(d$module)
    lapply(combs, function(grp) {
      g1 <- grp[1]
      g2 <- grp[2]
      dat <- d %>% filter(Group %in% grp) %>% mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp))
      data.frame(
        module_key = mk,
        module = mod_label,
        comparison = paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2),
        group1 = g1,
        group2 = g2,
        n1 = sum(dat$Group == g1, na.rm = TRUE),
        n2 = sum(dat$Group == g2, na.rm = TRUE),
        median1 = median(dat$module_proportion[dat$Group == g1], na.rm = TRUE),
        median2 = median(dat$module_proportion[dat$Group == g2], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean1 = mean(dat$module_proportion[dat$Group == g1], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean2 = mean(dat$module_proportion[dat$Group == g2], na.rm = TRUE),
        p.value = suppressWarnings(
          tryCatch(
            wilcox.test(
              dat$module_proportion[dat$Group == g1],
              dat$module_proportion[dat$Group == g2]
            )$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          )
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }) %>% bind_rows()
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  if (nrow(out) == 0) {
    return(out)
  }
  out <- out %>%
    group_by(module_key) %>%
    mutate(
      FDR = if (all(is.na(p.value))) NA_real_ else p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  out$log2FC <- log2((out$median1 + 1e-6) / (out$median2 + 1e-6))
  out$effect_size <- out$median1 - out$median2
  out
}

# ============================================================================
# CLR / Aitchison PCoA (restricted to target families)
# ============================================================================
clr_transform <- function(mat) {
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  pos <- mat[mat > 0]
  delta <- if (length(pos) > 0) min(pos) / 2 else 0.5
  mat[mat == 0] <- delta
  t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) log(x) - mean(log(x))))
}

run_beta <- function(prop_wide, group_levels) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(prop_wide)
  dat <- prop_wide %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))

  mat <- as.matrix(dat[, fams, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(mat) <- dat$sample_id
  clr <- clr_transform(mat)
  d <- dist(clr, method = "euclidean")

  set.seed(42)
  ad <- adonis2(d ~ Group, data = dat, permutations = 999)
  disp <- anova(betadisper(d, dat$Group))

  pcoa <- cmdscale(d, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  eig <- pcoa$eig[pcoa$eig > 0]
  var_explained <- if (length(eig) >= 2) {
    round(eig[1:2] / sum(eig) * 100, 1)
  } else {
    c(NA_real_, NA_real_)
  }

  scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)
  colnames(scores) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
  scores$sample_id <- rownames(scores)
  scores <- scores %>%
    left_join(dat %>% select(sample_id, Group), by = "sample_id")

  list(
    scores = scores,
    var_explained = var_explained,
    r2 = ad$R2[1],
    p = ad$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    disp_p = disp$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}

plot_pcoa <- function(beta, group_levels, title) {
  scores <- beta$scores
  centroids <- scores %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
      PCoA1 = mean(PCoA1, na.rm = TRUE),
      PCoA2 = mean(PCoA2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  subtitle <- sprintf(
    "PERMANOVA R2 = %.3f, P = %s | dispersion P = %s",
    beta$r2,
    format_p(beta$p),
    format_p(beta$disp_p)
  )

  ggplot(scores, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Group, fill = Group)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.65, size = 2.2) +
    geom_point(
      data = centroids,
      shape = 21,
      size = 5.5,
      stroke = 1.2,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.25) +
    scale_color_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = sprintf("PCoA1 (%.1f%%)", beta$var_explained[1]),
      y = sprintf("PCoA2 (%.1f%%)", beta$var_explained[2]),
      color = "Group",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15)
}

# ============================================================================
# Targeted-family differential analysis
# ============================================================================
differential_analysis <- function(prop_long, count_wide, group_levels) {
  fams <- get_family_cols(count_wide)
  dat <- count_wide %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = group_levels))

  present_fams <- fams[
    colSums(dat[, fams, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
  ]

  use_aldex <- requireNamespace("ALDEx2", quietly = TRUE)
  method <- "Kruskal-Wallis + BH (ALDEx2 not installed)"
  res <- NULL

  if (use_aldex && length(present_fams) > 1) {
    count_mat <- as.matrix(dat[, present_fams, drop = FALSE])
    rownames(count_mat) <- dat$sample_id
    set.seed(42)
    al <- tryCatch(
      ALDEx2::aldex(
        count_mat,
        dat$Group,
        mc.samples = 128,
        test = "kw",
        effect = TRUE,
        denom = "all"
      ),
      error = function(e) e
    )

    if (!inherits(al, "error")) {
      res <- data.frame(
        family = rownames(al),
        p.value = al$kw.ep,
        FDR = al$kw.eBH,
        aldex_effect = al$effect,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      method <- "ALDEx2 Kruskal-Wallis (Monte Carlo CLR; 128 Dirichlet samples)"
      use_aldex <- TRUE
    } else {
      use_aldex <- FALSE
      warning("ALDEx2 failed; falling back to Kruskal-Wallis: ", conditionMessage(al))
    }
  } else {
    use_aldex <- FALSE
  }

  if (!use_aldex) {
    res <- prop_long %>%
      group_by(family) %>%
      summarise(
        p.value = suppressWarnings(
          tryCatch(
            kruskal.test(proportion, Group)$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          )
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    res$FDR <- NA_real_
    idx <- !is.na(res$p.value)
    res$FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(res$p.value[idx], method = "BH")
    res$aldex_effect <- NA_real_
  }

  stats <- prop_long %>%
    group_by(family, Group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_prop = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_prop = median(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_prop = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  median_wide <- stats %>%
    select(family, Group, median_prop) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = median_prop)
  mean_wide <- stats %>%
    select(family, Group, mean_prop) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = mean_prop)

  med_cols <- setdiff(colnames(median_wide), "family")
  mean_cols <- setdiff(colnames(mean_wide), "family")
  median_mat <- as.matrix(median_wide[, med_cols, drop = FALSE])
  mean_mat <- as.matrix(mean_wide[, mean_cols, drop = FALSE])

  effect_size <- apply(
    median_mat,
    1,
    function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  log2fc <- log2(
    (apply(median_mat, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-6) /
      (apply(median_mat, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE) + 1e-6)
  )
  mean_range <- apply(
    mean_mat,
    1,
    function(x) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  effect_df <- data.frame(
    family = median_wide$family,
    effect_size = effect_size,
    log2FC = log2fc,
    mean_range = mean_range,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  res <- res %>%
    left_join(effect_df, by = "family") %>%
    left_join(median_wide, by = "family") %>%
    left_join(mean_wide, by = "family") %>%
    mutate(class = cazyme_class(family)) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(effect_size)))

  attr(res, "method") <- method
  res
}

plot_volcano_module <- function(
  diff_res,
  title,
  subtitle = "FDR from ALDEx2 or Kruskal-Wallis; effect size = range of group median proportions",
  x_label = "Effect size (max-min group median proportion)"
) {
  dat <- diff_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(FDR), !is.na(effect_size))
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  dat$FDR <- pmax(dat$FDR, 1e-300)
  sig <- dat %>%
    filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(effect_size))) %>%
    head(15)

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = effect_size, y = -log10(FDR), color = primary_module)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey30",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = MODULE_COLORS, labels = MODULE_LABELS[names(MODULE_COLORS)]) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = x_label,
      y = expression(-log[10](FDR)),
      color = "Target module"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 15) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 10, b = 20, l = 8))

  if (nrow(sig) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_text_repel(
        data = sig,
        aes(label = family),
        size = 3.6,
        max.overlaps = 30,
        box.padding = 0.4,
        segment.color = "grey50",
        segment.size = 0.3,
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
  }
  p
}

plot_top_family_boxplots <- function(prop_long, diff_res, group_levels) {
  sig <- diff_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(FDR)) %>%
    arrange(FDR, desc(abs(effect_size))) %>%
    head(12)
  if (nrow(sig) == 0) {
    sig <- diff_res %>% arrange(desc(abs(effect_size))) %>% head(12)
  }

  sub <- prop_long %>%
    filter(family %in% sig$family) %>%
    mutate(family = factor(family, levels = sig$family))

  ggplot(sub, aes(x = Group, y = proportion, fill = Group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.65, width = 0.55) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.35, color = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~family, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_COLORS[group_levels]) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
    labs(
      title = "Top Differential Target CAZyme Families",
      x = "Group",
      y = "Proportion (coverage-weighted)",
      fill = "Group"
    ) +
    theme_nature(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 11),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 8, b = 8, l = 12)
    )
}

# ============================================================================
# Prevalence
# ============================================================================
prevalence_summary <- function(count_long, group_levels) {
  count_long %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    group_by(Group, family) %>%
    summarise(
      n_present = sum(count > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples = n(),
      prevalence = 100 * sum(count > 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

plot_prevalence_heatmap_module <- function(
  prev,
  group_levels,
  filename,
  width = 5,
  height = 9
) {
  prev_wide <- prev %>%
    select(family, Group, prevalence) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = prevalence) %>%
    column_to_rownames("family") %>%
    as.matrix()
  prev_wide <- prev_wide[
    ,
    group_levels[group_levels %in% colnames(prev_wide)],
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  ann_vals <- factor(
    primary_module(rownames(prev_wide)),
    levels = names(MODULE_COLORS)
  )
  ann_row <- data.frame(
    Module = ann_vals,
    row.names = rownames(prev_wide)
  )

  pheatmap(
    prev_wide,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    annotation_row = ann_row,
    annotation_colors = list(Module = MODULE_COLORS),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#FDBE85", "#B2182B"))(100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, length.out = 101),
    border_color = "grey85",
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 11,
    fontsize_col = 12,
    main = "Target CAZyme Family Prevalence (%)",
    filename = filename,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# Pairwise (family level)
# ============================================================================
pairwise_groups <- function(prop_long, group_levels) {
  group_levels <- group_levels[group_levels %in% prop_long$Group]
  if (length(group_levels) < 2) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  combs <- combn(group_levels, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  out <- lapply(combs, function(grp) {
    g1 <- grp[1]
    g2 <- grp[2]
    dat <- prop_long %>%
      filter(Group %in% grp) %>%
      mutate(Group = factor(Group, levels = grp))

    res <- dat %>%
      group_by(family) %>%
      summarise(
        n1 = sum(Group == g1),
        n2 = sum(Group == g2),
        median1 = median(proportion[Group == g1], na.rm = TRUE),
        median2 = median(proportion[Group == g2], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean1 = mean(proportion[Group == g1], na.rm = TRUE),
        mean2 = mean(proportion[Group == g2], na.rm = TRUE),
        p.value = suppressWarnings(
          tryCatch(
            wilcox.test(
              proportion[Group == g1],
              proportion[Group == g2]
            )$p.value,
            error = function(e) NA_real_
          )
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    res$FDR <- NA_real_
    idx <- !is.na(res$p.value)
    res$FDR[idx] <- p.adjust(res$p.value[idx], method = "BH")
    res$log2FC <- log2(
      (res$median1 + 1e-6) / (res$median2 + 1e-6)
    )
    res$effect_size <- res$median1 - res$median2
    res$group1 <- g1
    res$group2 <- g2
    res$comparison <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)
    res
  })

  bind_rows(out)
}

write_pairwise_matrices <- function(pairwise, tables_dir, prefix = "mucin") {
  if (nrow(pairwise) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  comparisons <- unique(pairwise$comparison)
  families <- unique(pairwise$family)

  matrix_from_pairwise <- function(value_col) {
    mat <- matrix(
      NA_real_,
      nrow = length(families),
      ncol = length(comparisons),
      dimnames = list(families, comparisons)
    )
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairwise))) {
      mat[pairwise$family[i], pairwise$comparison[i]] <-
        pairwise[[value_col]][i]
    }
    mat
  }

  write_results(
    cbind(
      family = rownames(matrix_from_pairwise("log2FC")),
      as.data.frame(matrix_from_pairwise("log2FC"), check.names = FALSE)
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(prefix, "_pairwise_log2FC_matrix.tsv"))
  )
  write_results(
    cbind(
      family = rownames(matrix_from_pairwise("FDR")),
      as.data.frame(matrix_from_pairwise("FDR"), check.names = FALSE)
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(prefix, "_pairwise_FDR_matrix.tsv"))
  )
  write_results(
    cbind(
      family = rownames(matrix_from_pairwise("effect_size")),
      as.data.frame(matrix_from_pairwise("effect_size"), check.names = FALSE)
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, paste0(prefix, "_pairwise_effect_size_matrix.tsv"))
  )
}

save_pairwise_heatmap <- function(
  pairwise,
  filename,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 9
) {
  if (nrow(pairwise) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  sig_fams <- pairwise %>%
    filter(!is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.05) %>%
    pull(family) %>%
    unique()
  if (length(sig_fams) == 0) {
    sig_fams <- pairwise %>%
      group_by(family) %>%
      summarise(min_fdr = min(FDR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(min_fdr) %>%
      head(40) %>%
      pull(family)
  }
  if (length(sig_fams) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  mat <- pairwise %>%
    filter(family %in% sig_fams) %>%
    select(family, comparison, log2FC) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = comparison, values_from = log2FC) %>%
    column_to_rownames("family") %>%
    as.matrix()
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

  finite_vals <- mat[is.finite(mat)]
  if (any(is.infinite(mat))) {
    max_abs <- max(abs(finite_vals), na.rm = TRUE)
    mat[is.infinite(mat)] <- sign(mat[is.infinite(mat)]) * max_abs
  }
  if (max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  lim <- max(abs(mat), na.rm = TRUE)

  ann_vals <- factor(
    primary_module(rownames(mat)),
    levels = names(MODULE_COLORS)
  )
  ann_row <- data.frame(
    Module = ann_vals,
    row.names = rownames(mat)
  )

  pheatmap(
    mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    annotation_row = ann_row,
    annotation_colors = list(Module = MODULE_COLORS),
    color = colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100),
    breaks = seq(-lim, lim, length.out = 101),
    border_color = "grey85",
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 11,
    fontsize_col = 12,
    main = "Pairwise Log2FC (FDR-significant target families)",
    filename = filename,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# Orchestrators
# ============================================================================
restrict_to_targets <- function(dat, tfams) {
  dat[, c("sample_id", "source", "Group", tfams), drop = FALSE]
}

run_mucin_outputs <- function(
  prop_cov,
  count_wide,
  group_levels,
  output_dir,
  title_tag
) {
  dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tables_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")

  cat("\nTargeted module processing:", title_tag, "->", output_dir, "\n")

  tfams <- target_families(prop_cov)
  cat("  Target families available:", length(tfams), "\n")
  missing <- setdiff(unique(unlist(MODULES)), tfams)
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    cat("  Not found in data:", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  if (length(tfams) == 0) {
    cat("  No target families available. Skipping.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  prop_r <- restrict_to_targets(prop_cov, tfams)
  count_r <- restrict_to_targets(count_wide, intersect(tfams, colnames(count_wide)))

  # --- module aggregate ---
  mod_agg <- module_aggregate(prop_cov, count_wide)
  mod_agg$Group <- factor(mod_agg$Group, levels = group_levels)
  mod_group_sum <- module_group_summary(mod_agg)
  mod_kw <- module_kw_stats(mod_agg)
  write_results(
    left_join(mod_group_sum, mod_kw, by = c("module_key", "module")),
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_module_aggregate_summary.tsv")
  )
  write_results(
    mod_agg,
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_module_long.tsv")
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_module_boxplots(
      mod_agg,
      group_levels,
      paste(title_tag, "Targeted Module Degradation Potential")
    ),
    "figM1_mucin_module_boxplots",
    output_dir,
    width = 7,
    height = 5.5
  )

  # --- CLR PCoA restricted to target families ---
  beta <- run_beta(prop_r, group_levels)
  write_results(
    data.frame(
      analysis = title_tag,
      method = "Aitchison PCoA (CLR + Euclidean distance) on target families",
      PERMANOVA_R2 = beta$r2,
      PERMANOVA_P = beta$p,
      Dispersion_P = beta$disp_p,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_permanova_stats.tsv")
  )
  write_results(
    beta$scores,
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_aitchison_pcoa_scores.tsv")
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_pcoa(beta, group_levels, paste(title_tag, "Targeted CAZyme Aitchison PCoA")),
    "figM5_mucin_clr_pcoa",
    output_dir,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )

  # --- family-level differential ---
  prop_long <- make_long(prop_r, "proportion")
  count_long <- make_long(count_r, "count")
  diff_res <- differential_analysis(prop_long, count_r, group_levels)
  diff_res$module <- module_annotation(diff_res$family)
  diff_res$primary_module <- primary_module(diff_res$family)
  cat("  Differential method:", attr(diff_res, "method"), "\n")
  write_results(
    diff_res,
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_target_family_differential.tsv")
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_volcano_module(
      diff_res,
      paste(title_tag, "Targeted CAZyme Differential Volcano")
    ),
    "figM2_mucin_family_volcano",
    output_dir,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
  save_figure(
    plot_top_family_boxplots(prop_long, diff_res, group_levels),
    "figM3_mucin_top_family_boxplots",
    output_dir,
    width = 10,
    height = 7
  )

  # --- family summary + prevalence ---
  fam_sum <- prop_long %>%
    group_by(Group, family) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_prop = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_prop = median(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_prop = sd(proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      module = module_annotation(family),
      primary_module = primary_module(family)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Group, primary_module, family)
  write_results(
    fam_sum,
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_target_family_summary.tsv")
  )

  prev <- prevalence_summary(count_long, group_levels)
  prev$module <- module_annotation(prev$family)
  prev$primary_module <- primary_module(prev$family)
  write_results(
    prev,
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_target_prevalence_summary.tsv")
  )
  plot_prevalence_heatmap_module(
    prev,
    group_levels,
    file.path(output_dir, "figM4_mucin_prevalence_heatmap.png"),
    width = 5,
    height = 9
  )

  write_results(
    prop_long,
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_target_proportion_long.tsv")
  )
  write_results(
    count_long,
    file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_target_present_count_long.tsv")
  )

  cat("  Finished:", title_tag, "\n")
}

run_mucin_pairwise <- function(
  prop_cov,
  count_wide,
  group_levels,
  output_dir,
  title_tag
) {
  dir.create(file.path(output_dir, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tables_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "tables")

  cat("\nTargeted pairwise processing:", title_tag, "->", output_dir, "\n")

  tfams <- target_families(prop_cov)
  if (length(tfams) == 0) {
    cat("  No target families available. Skipping pairwise.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  prop_r <- restrict_to_targets(prop_cov, tfams)
  count_r <- restrict_to_targets(count_wide, intersect(tfams, colnames(count_wide)))
  prop_long <- make_long(prop_r, "proportion")

  pairwise <- pairwise_groups(prop_long, group_levels)
  if (nrow(pairwise) > 0) {
    pairwise$module <- module_annotation(pairwise$family)
    pairwise$primary_module <- primary_module(pairwise$family)
    write_results(
      pairwise,
      file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_family_pairwise_results.tsv")
    )
    write_pairwise_matrices(pairwise, tables_dir)

    comparison_summary <- pairwise %>%
      group_by(comparison, group1, group2, n1, n2) %>%
      summarise(
        n_families = n(),
        n_significant_FDR_0.05 = sum(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_upregulated_in_group1 = sum(log2FC > 0 & FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_downregulated_in_group1 = sum(log2FC < 0 & FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(comparison)
    write_results(
      comparison_summary,
      file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_family_pairwise_comparison_summary.tsv")
    )

    save_pairwise_heatmap(
      pairwise,
      file.path(output_dir, "figS2_mucin_pairwise_differential_heatmap.png"),
      width = 6.5,
      height = 9
    )

    comparisons <- unique(pairwise$comparison)
    for (cc in comparisons) {
      cc_dat <- pairwise %>% filter(comparison == cc)
      prefix <- paste0(
        "figS1_mucin_pairwise_volcano_",
        gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", cc)
      )
      save_figure(
        plot_volcano_module(
          cc_dat,
          paste(title_tag, "Targeted CAZyme Pairwise Volcano:", cc),
          subtitle = "Wilcoxon rank-sum test with BH FDR; effect size = median1 - median2",
          x_label = "Effect size (median group1 - median group2)"
        ),
        prefix,
        output_dir,
        width = 6,
        height = 5.5
      )
    }
  }

  # --- module-level pairwise ---
  mod_agg <- module_aggregate(prop_cov, count_wide)
  mod_agg$Group <- factor(mod_agg$Group, levels = group_levels)
  mod_pair <- module_pairwise(mod_agg)
  if (nrow(mod_pair) > 0) {
    write_results(
      mod_pair,
      file.path(tables_dir, "mucin_module_pairwise_results.tsv")
    )
  }

  cat("  Finished pairwise:", title_tag, "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# Main
# ============================================================================
cat("Reading Step 9 annotated CAZyme tables...\n")
prop_cov_all <- read_annotated(PROP_COV_FILE)
prop_len_cov_all <- read_annotated(PROP_LEN_COV_FILE)
score_cov_all <- read_annotated(SCORE_COV_FILE)

cat("Target families requested per module:\n")
for (.m in names(MODULES)) {
  cat("  ", MODULE_LABELS[[.m]], " (", .m, "): ",
      length(MODULES[[.m]]), " families\n", sep = "")
}

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}
if (!dir.exists(FOUR_GROUP_OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(FOUR_GROUP_OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}
if (!dir.exists(PAIRWISE_OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(PAIRWISE_OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}
if (!dir.exists(PAIRWISE_FOUR_OUTPUT_DIR)) {
  dir.create(PAIRWISE_FOUR_OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)
}

prop_cov_4 <- subset_group(prop_cov_all, FOUR_GROUP_LEVELS)
count_4 <- subset_group(count_all, FOUR_GROUP_LEVELS)

run_mucin_outputs(
  prop_cov_all,

)

run_mucin_outputs(
  prop_cov_4,
  count_4,
  FOUR_GROUP_LEVELS,
  FOUR_GROUP_OUTPUT_DIR,
  "Follow-up groups"
)

run_mucin_pairwise(
  prop_cov_all,

)

run_mucin_pairwise(

cat("\n==============================================================\n")
cat(" Targeted module (mucin/chitin/plant) analysis complete\n")
cat(" Main output:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
cat(" Follow-up output:", FOUR_GROUP_OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
cat(" Pairwise output:", PAIRWISE_OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
```

## 5.3 Results

**Module-level Kruskal-Wallis (4-group, on module proportion):**

| Module | mean proportion (Re1 → Non2) | KW p |
|--------|------------------------------|------|
| Plant polysaccharide degradation | 0.102 → 0.101 | 0.178 |
| Chitin utilization | 0.028 → 0.029 | 0.396 |
| Mucin degradation (extended) | 0.050 → 0.051 | 0.671 |
| Mucin degradation (core) | 0.029 → 0.031 | 0.676 |

**PERMANOVA (4-group, target families):** R² = 0.0124, P = 0.503,
dispersion P = 0.343.

**Target-family differential (top raw-p):** GH26 (plant) p = 0.0104,
FDR = 0.418; GH53 (plant) p = 0.072; CE1 (plant) p = 0.106.

## 5.5 Interpretation

1. **No mucin / glycan module is significant**; mucin-degradation capacity is
   stable across recurrence status and sampling time.
2. The strongest trend is plant polysaccharide degradation (p = 0.178), driven
   mainly by GH26 and consistent with the dbCAN3 per-family result.
3. Module-level testing reduces the burden from ~300 families to 4 tests, but
   effect sizes are too small to reach significance at n = 236.
# 6. Overall interpretation

1. **All three phenotype-prediction tools agree: no predicted phenotype differs
   significantly between the four adenoma follow-up groups** in per-feature or
   multivariate tests.
2. **Top raw-p candidates are biologically coherent but not significant.** They
   point to carbohydrate metabolism, polysaccharide transport, and plant/mucin
   glycan degradation, but remain hypothesis-generating leads.
3. **Multivariate separation is absent.** PERMANOVA R2 is about 0.012-0.015
   with P = 0.20-0.55; betadisper is non-significant except for 6-group Traitar
   (P = 0.043, a dispersion rather than location effect).
4. **Implications.** At n = 236 (4-group) the cohort is underpowered after
   correction for 60-300 tests. The targeted module approach is the right scale
   and shows the expected direction without reaching significance. Next steps:
   increase sample size, focus on pre-specified modules, and integrate with the
   paired delta analysis.
